news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers update on James and Walsh ahead of Roma
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特在罗马之前发布了詹姆斯和沃尔什的最新消息
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed that she has a full squad to select from for Wednesday night’s Women’s Champions League fixture against Roma, including Lauren James and Keira Walsh. The duo were missing for Sunday’s 3-1 win over Crystal Palace, but will be available for selection for the European action at Plough Lane tomorrow. The Blues are unbeaten this season and are looking to build on a win against Austria Vienna and a hard-fought draw away at Lyon at the end of September in the competition's league phase. ‘I have the full squad available,’ Bompastor confirmed. ‘It's giving me a lot of headaches, but good ones. I will have to make some decisions about the game tomorrow, but the squad is really competitive right now. ‘Everyone is performing at a high level, so we will have a really good team starting the game and being very competitive. ‘As you could see in the recent games, the players who have come in have had a real impact. So really good news, and it's positive that everyone is available.’ Bompastor also added an extra update about two players who have been out of action longer term. She said: 'Naomi [Girma] just started to come back on the pitch and run again, so it's a good update. And in terms of Mayra [Ramirez], no more updates for now.' Nine wins and two draws in our opening 11 games give the head coach reason to be optimistic, but she is keen to make sure that her side don't take their foot off the gas. ‘I’m really pleased with the results for sure: not only the results, but it’s also the performances we had in the different games and competitions,’ she continued. ‘Right now, the way we are performing gives us a really good advantage and a big chance to win the games, so we need to keep working hard. ‘We need to keep the right mindset and mentality going into every game and make sure we always put in the best performance possible for us to win the games.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认，她有完整的阵容可供选择参加周三晚上对阵罗马的女子冠军联赛比赛，其中包括劳伦·詹姆斯和凯拉·沃尔什。两人缺席了周日 3-1 战胜水晶宫的比赛，但明天将可以参加在普劳巷举行的欧洲比赛。蓝军本赛季保持不败，并希望在联赛阶段战胜奥地利维也纳和客场战平里昂的基础上再接再厉。 “我有完整的阵容，”邦帕斯特证实。 “这让我很头疼，但也很好。”我必须对明天的比赛做出一些决定，但球队现在真的很有竞争力。 “每个人都表现得很高水平，所以我们将拥有一支非常优秀的球队，开始比赛并且非常有竞争力。 “正如你在最近的比赛中看到的那样，上场的球员产生了真正的影响。这确实是个好消息，而且每个人都可以参加比赛，这是积极的。”邦帕斯特还补充了关于两名长期缺席比赛的球员的额外更新。她说：“内奥米（吉尔玛）刚刚开始回到球场并再次奔跑，所以这是一个很好的更新。至于 Mayra [Ramirez]，目前没有更多更新。我们前 11 场比赛中的 9 胜 2 平让主教练有理由保持乐观，但她渴望确保她的球队不会放松警惕。 “我对结果确实很满意：不仅是结果，还有我们在不同比赛和比赛中的表现，”她继续说道。 “现在，我们的表现给了我们很大的优势，并且有很大的机会赢得比赛，所以我们需要继续努力。 “我们需要在每场比赛中保持正确的心态和心态，确保我们始终拿出最好的表现来赢得比赛。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Emmanuel Emegha’s 'special qualities' and striker options
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈伊曼纽尔·埃梅加的“特殊品质”和前锋选择
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has been discussing his potential attacking options for Wednesday’s trip to Liverpool, believing Emmanuel Emegha’s return to the squad could be timely in Joao Pedro’s absence. Chelsea travel to Anfield for a Carabao Cup fourth-round tie tomorrow evening, when Alonso will be returning to the stadium where he enjoyed plenty of success as a player. Now the Blues manager, he will make the trip without striker Joao Pedro in his team, with the Brazilian ruled out by a thigh injury. However, that blow could be softened by the presence in the squad of summer signing Emegha, who has returned from injury and could make his Chelsea debut against the Reds. ‘For sure it’s important that we have him available because he has special qualities,’ said Alonso in his pre-match press conference on Tuesday afternoon. ‘He needs to feel fully fit. He has been training for the last two weeks, ten days, in a good way that has allowed him to build a strong base of fitness. ‘Now, gradually, we want to see him and maybe tomorrow he has the chance to play.’ Alongside Emegha, another summer arrival at Chelsea, Danny Welbeck, is also available to lead the Blues’ attack. There are also other solutions, as seen at the weekend when Morgan Rogers played further forward in the striker’s role. Those solutions, and others, are all being considered by Alonso ahead of Wednesday’s game against Liverpool and the others that lie ahead during Joao Pedro’s absence. ‘There are the strikers, but there are other players that can play in that position,’ our manager continued. ‘We need to find the right balance between the things they are good at and how they connect with the other players. ‘We tried with Morgan playing close to Cole [Palmer], and sometimes we need to be creative and try a few things to see if they are going to work well. ‘I assess all the possibilities we have and what we have been preparing during the week, and with the qualities all players have, to choose the best team for each game. That was the case for Saturday and that is the case for tomorrow.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索一直在讨论他周三客场利物浦的潜在进攻选择，他相信在若昂·佩德罗缺席的情况下，伊曼纽尔·埃梅加可能会及时回归球队。明天晚上，切尔西将前往安菲尔德参加卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛，届时阿隆索将回到他作为球员取得过巨大成功的球场。现在担任蓝军主教练的他将在没有前锋若奥·佩德罗的情况下出访，巴西人因大腿受伤而缺席。然而，夏季签约埃梅加的出现可能会减轻这一打击，埃梅加已经伤愈复出，并可能在对阵红军的比赛中上演切尔西首秀。 “当然，我们让他上场很重要，因为他具有特殊的品质，”阿隆索在周二下午的赛前新闻发布会上说道。 “他需要感觉完全健康。过去两周十天，他一直在进行良好的训练，这让他建立了坚实的体能基础。 “现在，我们逐渐希望见到他，也许明天他就有机会上场。”除了埃梅加之外，另一位夏季加盟切尔西的丹尼·维尔贝克也可以领导蓝军的进攻。还有其他解决方案，正如周末摩根·罗杰斯在前锋角色中扮演更靠前的位置所看到的那样。在周三对阵利物浦的比赛之前，阿隆索正在考虑这些解决方案以及其他解决方案，以及若昂·佩德罗缺席期间即将到来的其他解决方案。 “有前锋，但还有其他球员可以踢这个位置，”我们的主教练继续说道。 “我们需要在他们擅长的事情以及他们与其他球员的联系方式之间找到适当的平衡。 “我们尝试让摩根与科尔[帕尔默]打得更近，有时我们需要发挥创造力，尝试一些事情，看看它们是否会运作良好。 “我评估了我们拥有的所有可能性以及我们在这一周所做的准备，并根据所有球员的素质，为每场比赛选择最好的球队。周六是这样，明天也是这样。”

news.title: Message to Chelsea supporters at Anfield this week
news.title_zh: 本周在安菲尔德致切尔西球迷的信息
news.body_en: Ahead of our upcoming Carabao Cup tie against Liverpool, we want to remind ticket holders of their responsibilities when representing Chelsea and explain how to report discriminatory or abusive behaviour. We are incredibly proud of the role our supporters play in ensuring the team has fantastic support, both at home at Stamford Bridge and when travelling away. We know that the majority of our supporters continue to represent Chelsea in a respectful and positive way, and we thank all of you for the continued time and effort you show in backing the team. We understand that singing and chanting are an important part of the matchday experience, and we encourage all supporters to get behind the team in the passionate and vocal way we always experience. However, there have been incidents involving discriminatory or abusive behaviour, including reports of sectarian abuse and tragedy chanting. This behaviour has no place in football and only serves to cause hurt to others. This season, we have seen an increase in sectarianism at away fixtures. The club operates a zero-tolerance approach to chanting that creates division towards a particular religious or political group. Anyone found engaging in such behaviour will face the strongest possible action, which could include suspension from attending all Chelsea matches as well as potential police action. The Crown Prosecution Service (CPS) considers tragedy-related abuse a prosecutable public order offence, which may result in the issuing of football banning orders. The CPS defines tragedy-related abuse as ‘when fans sing, chant or gesture offensive messages about disasters involving players or fans.’ The majority of our supporters share our commitment to ensuring Chelsea matches remain safe and welcoming for everyone. You can help by reporting any discriminatory language or abuse you hear at Anfield to your nearest steward or by texting the details to Liverpool’s reporting number, 07701 411048. Alternatively, you can report it directly to us after the game by clicking here to use our dedicated reporting form. Thank you for your continued support and for helping us represent Chelsea FC in a positive and respectful way. We look forward to seeing you at Anfield.
news.body_zh: 在即将到来的卡拉宝杯对阵利物浦的比赛之前，我们希望提醒持票人代表切尔西时的责任，并解释如何举报歧视或虐待行为。我们为我们的支持者所发挥的作用感到无比自豪，他们确保球队无论在主场还是在客场都能获得出色的支持。我们知道，我们的大多数支持者继续以尊重和积极的方式代表切尔西，我们感谢你们所有人为支持球队而付出的持续时间和努力。我们知道唱歌和口号是比赛日体验的重要组成部分，我们鼓励所有支持者以我们一直体验到的热情和声音方式支持球队。然而，也曾发生过涉及歧视或虐待行为的事件，包括宗派虐待和悲剧口号的报道。这种行为在足球界没有立足之地，只会对他人造成伤害。本赛季，我们在客场比赛中看到宗派主义有所增加。该俱乐部对高喊口号采取零容忍态度，这会造成对特定宗教或政治团体的分裂。任何被发现有此类行为的人都将面临最严厉的处罚，其中可能包括暂停观看所有切尔西比赛以及警方可能采取的行动。皇家检察署 (CPS) 将与悲剧相关的虐待行为视为可起诉的公共秩序犯罪，这可能会导致发布足球禁令。 CPS 将与悲剧相关的虐待行为定义为“当球迷就涉及球员或球迷的灾难唱歌、喊口号或做出攻击性信息时。”我们的大多数支持者都同意我们的承诺，即确保切尔西比赛保持安全并欢迎所有人。您可以通过向最近的管理员举报您在安菲尔德听到的任何歧视性语言或辱骂行为，或将详细信息发送至利物浦的举报电话 07701 411048 来提供帮助。或者，您也可以在赛后单击此处使用我们的专用举报表直接向我们举报。感谢您一直以来的支持，并帮助我们以积极和尊重的方式代表切尔西足球俱乐部。我们期待在安菲尔德见到您。

news.title: The Stamford Cup returns to Stamford Bridge in 2027
news.title_zh: 斯坦福杯将于 2027 年重返斯坦福桥
news.body_en: Football, teamwork and unforgettable experiences will come together once again when the Stamford Cup is held at our stadium next year. Offering a unique opportunity to play at one of the world's most iconic football venues, the Stamford Cup invites businesses, organisations and groups of friends to step onto the famous pitch and compete in a professionally delivered tournament at the home of Chelsea Football Club. Whether you are looking to reward employees, strengthen client relationships or enjoy a memorable day out with mates, the Stamford Cup delivers far more than just football. It is a chance to experience the thrill of matchday from a player's perspective, create lasting memories and build stronger connections through competition and camaraderie. Compete in an exclusive tournament on the Stamford Bridge pitch, where legends have played and football memories are made. Led by Chelsea FC Development professionals, teams will experience the standards, coaching and matchday atmosphere of a Premier League club from the moment they arrive. Walk out through the tunnel, take to the famous turf and compete for glory before celebrating an on-pitch trophy presentation, just like the pros. The experience extends beyond the pitch, with complimentary spectator access for friends and family, giving your supporters a chance to be part of the occasion. After the final whistle, continue the celebrations with a post-match BBQ and bar access, while professional event photography captures the highlights of an unforgettable day. And most importantly, the winning team will lift a bespoke Stamford Cup trophy engraved with their team name, before receiving a special presentation at a Chelsea FC Premier League home fixture in 2028. Interest is expected to be high for the 2027 tournament. Register your interest today to receive priority updates, exclusive event information and early access to secure your place when registrations open.
news.body_zh: 明年斯坦福杯在我们的体育场举行时，足球、团队合作和难忘的经历将再次汇聚在一起。斯坦福杯提供了在世界上最具标志性的足球场之一进行比赛的独特机会，邀请企业、组织和朋友团体踏上著名的球场，在切尔西足球俱乐部的主场参加专业举办的锦标赛。无论您是想奖励员工、加强客户关系还是与朋友一起度过难忘的一天，斯坦福杯提供的不仅仅是足球。这是一个从球员的角度体验比赛日的刺激、创造持久记忆并通过竞争和友情建立更牢固联系的机会。在斯坦福桥球场参加一场独家锦标赛，传奇人物曾在这里踢球，留下足球回忆。在切尔西足球俱乐部发展专业人士的带领下，球队从抵达那一刻起就将体验英超俱乐部的标准、教练和比赛氛围。走出隧道，来到著名的草坪，争夺荣耀，然后像职业球员一样在球场上庆祝奖杯颁奖。这种体验超越了球场，为朋友和家人提供免费观众入场，让您的支持者有机会参与其中。终场哨声响起后，您可以通过赛后烧烤和进入酒吧继续庆祝活动，同时专业的活动摄影捕捉难忘一天的亮点。最重要的是，获胜球队将举起刻有球队名字的定制斯坦福杯奖杯，然后在 2028 年切尔西足球俱乐部英超主场比赛中接受特别展示。预计 2027 年赛事的兴趣将会很高。立即注册您的兴趣，以获得优先更新、独家活动信息，并在注册开放时提前获得席位。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Liverpool
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为利物浦效力的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has confirmed that Joao Pedro will be ruled out for 'a few weeks' with a thigh injury, but the Blues manager will be able to call upon Emmanuel Emegha for tomorrow's Carabao Cup fourth-round tie at Liverpool. Joao Pedro has made an impressive start to the campaign, scoring five goals and registering three assists in seven matches. However, on the eve of Tottenham Hotspur's visit to Stamford Bridge on Saturday, the Brazilian suffered an injury in training. Joao Pedro has since undergone further tests, which have confirmed he is set for a spell on the sidelines, as Alonso detailed in his pre-match press conference ahead of our Carabao Cup clash at Anfield. He said: ‘He has an injury in his thigh and he’s going to be out for a few weeks. Let’s see how many; we don’t want to predict that. But he will not be ready for the next games. ‘He is a key player and we will miss him, but we have to be ready to deal with the injury, be competitive and try to win games with the players we have available, starting tomorrow against Liverpool, a cup game. 'This is the situation and we are ready to fight for it and prove we can show a good level.’ Alonso's attacking options have been boosted by the news that Emegha is in contention to feature in tomorrow's game. The 23-year-old striker has yet to make his Chelsea debut after arriving from Strasbourg in the summer, but has been building his fitness at Cobham over the last fortnight after recovering from a hamstring injury. And Alonso says the Netherlands international – in addition to Estevao and Danny Welbeck – can be called upon tomorrow evening. 'He is in the squad,' the Blues boss stated. One selection Alonso has already confirmed is that of Mike Penders. The Belgian goalkeeper made his Premier League debut against Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday and, unfortunately, conceded an own goal in our 2-0 defeat at Stamford Bridge. Alonso insists his confidence in the 21-year-old has not changed, and that Penders will learn and improve from the experience. ‘It’s a challenge to deal with good performances and mistakes, but that is part of the job, being a professional footballer playing at the highest level,' Alonso said. 'What happened on Saturday is in the past; it’s a lesson for him and everyone. We fully support him tomorrow.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索确认若奥·佩德罗因大腿受伤将缺席“几周”，但蓝军主教练将能够请伊曼纽尔·埃梅加参加明天对阵利物浦的卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛。若昂·佩德罗在本赛季取得了令人印象深刻的开局，在七场比赛中攻入 5 球并贡献 3 次助攻。然而，在周六托特纳姆热刺队造访斯坦福桥的前夕，巴西人在训练中受伤。此后，若昂·佩德罗接受了进一步的检查，这证实他将在场边待一段时间，正如阿隆索在安菲尔德举行的卡拉宝杯比赛前的赛前新闻发布会上详细介绍的那样。他说：“他的大腿受伤了，他将缺席几周的时间。让我们看看有多少；我们不想预测这一点。但他还没有为接下来的比赛做好准备。 “他是一名关键球员，我们会想念他，但我们必须做好应对伤病的准备，保持竞争力，并努力用我们现有的球员赢得比赛，从明天对阵利物浦的一场杯赛开始。 “情况就是这样，我们已经准备好为此而战，证明我们可以展现出良好的水平。”埃梅加有望参加明天比赛的消息增强了阿隆索的进攻选择。这位23岁的前锋今年夏天从斯特拉斯堡抵达后尚未在切尔西首次亮相，但在从腿筋伤势中恢复后，过去两周一直在科巴姆恢复健康。阿隆索表示，除了埃斯特沃和丹尼·维尔贝克之外，这位荷兰国脚也可以在明天晚上上场。 “他在球队中，”蓝军主帅说道。阿隆索已经确认的选择之一是迈克·彭德斯。这位比利时门将在周六对阵托特纳姆热刺队的英超联赛中首次亮相，但不幸的是，在我们0-2输给斯坦福桥的比赛中，他丢了一个乌龙球。阿隆索坚称他对这位 21 岁球员的信心没有改变，彭德斯将从这次经历中学习和提高。阿隆索说：“处理好的表现和错误是一个挑战，但这是工作的一部分，作为一名职业足球运动员，在最高水平上踢球。” “周六发生的事情已经过去了；这对他和每个人来说都是一个教训。明天我们全力支持他。”

news.title: Harry Hudson targeting togetherness in UEFA Youth League clash
news.title_zh: 哈里·哈德森的目标是在欧足联青年联赛冲突中团结一致
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen travel to Estonia on Wednesday for the first leg of our UEFA Youth League second round tie against Flora Tallinn. Ahead of the European clash, we spoke with CNG boss Harry Hudson, who highlighted the important of defensive organisation and togetherness. The UEFA Youth League offers valuable experience for our young players as they continue their development. The squad have been encouraged to embrace the challenge in Estonia, and show togetherness ahead of the contest at the Lillekula Stadium. Hudson describes Flora Tallinn as well coached and technically capable, but believes the Blues can use our physical qualities to our advantage. Chelsea’s recent performances have provided a strong foundation heading into the match, with Hudson pleased by the squad’s tactical flexibility throughout the start of the season. It’s been a hectic month for CNG, but the players have taken the challenges in their stride. Following the end of the international break, we beat senior opposition Reading and earned three points away at Stoke City three days later. In the build up to another tough test in its own right, Hudson revealed how the squad have been preparing. ‘There’s always a challenge with finding the time to specifically work for the Youth League,' he said. 'We were fortunate that the previous week we had no midweek game for the Under-18s or CNG. That allowed us to get an extra couple of days of training in. We’ve been quite creative with finding the time to prepare and we’ve had some really good sessions. ‘Flora Tallinn are very well coached, they have a very clear game plan, especially when in possession, and have some technical players. There are some threats we need to manage but we can utilise our physical strength.’ While Hudson highlighted Flora’s threats, he believes our success in the league can give us a boost in Europe. He said: ‘The majority of the boys have been playing for CNG so are in a decent place and doing well in PL2 at the moment. We can take that confidence into Tallinn.’ With confidence growing within the squad, Hudson is keen for the Blues to carry that momentum into Estonia. Unity and defensive deiscpline will be key to our approach tomorrow night. When the players step onto the pitch, the CNG manager said he wants to see ‘togetherness with and without the ball’. Hudson said: ‘We are going into a different environment with a different culture, so we need to be together, be one team and work for each other. ‘It’s a high jeopardy, two-legged tie where we have the advantage of playing the second game at home. The main priority is to defend as well as we can, then we know we’ve got talented individuals who can cause any team real problems.’ So far this season, our performances out of possession have laid the groundwork for our success, according to Hudson. He praised the players for how well they’ve taken on various game plans. The CNG manager said: ‘Wehave an ability to adapt and manage threats. If a team starts with something slightly different, we have an answer for that by having a structure that can be flexible to manage different threats. That’s what has given us the foundations for our success over the last six to eight weeks.’ The UEFA Youth League is a prestigious competition that gives players a fantastic opportunity to showcase their ability on the European stage. On the value that the competition provides, Hudson said: ‘We have players that will go on to play in the Champions League and across all European competitions, so these Youth League trips give the players an understanding of how to manage your schedule and the long travel. It is quite literally invaluable for that experience and exposure. ‘We had a workshop around our team identity and understanding that this is a high-jeopardy game, but we have the right attributes to deal with that pressure. The Youth League is probably the best youth competition in the world to showcase talent so we know the amazing experience this competition can give them.’ Beyond the result, Hudson is hoping to see the Blues play with a clear identity and demonstrate positive behaviours as a group. Ahead of kick-off, he revealed his final message to the players. ‘My final message goes back to that point of being together, being brace and working for each other. We are looking forward to playing different football cultures and trying to adapt and impose ourselves on this path in the competition.’
news.body_zh: 科巴姆下一代将于周三前往爱沙尼亚，参加欧洲青年联赛第二轮首回合对阵弗洛拉塔林的比赛。在欧洲比赛之前，我们采访了 CNG 老板 Harry Hudson，他强调了防守组织和团结的重要性。欧足联青年联赛为我们的年轻球员继续发展提供了宝贵的经验。我们鼓励球队迎接爱沙尼亚的挑战，并在利勒库拉体育场的比赛前表现出团结精神。哈德森形容弗洛拉·塔林训练有素，技术能力强，但相信蓝军可以利用我们的身体素质来发挥我们的优势。切尔西最近的表现为比赛奠定了坚实的基础，哈德森对球队在赛季初的战术灵活性感到满意。对于 CNG 来说，这是忙碌的一个月，但队员们从容应对挑战。国际比赛日结束后，我们击败了高级对手雷丁，并在三天后客场对阵斯托克城赢得了三分。在准备迎接另一场严峻的考验时，哈德森透露了球队的准备情况。 “找到时间专门为青年团工作总是一个挑战，”他说。 “我们很幸运，上周我们没有 18 岁以下组或 CNG 的周中比赛。这让我们获得了额外几天的培训时间。我们非常有创意地找到了时间进行准备，并且我们进行了一些非常好的课程。 “弗洛拉塔林队的教练非常好，他们有一个非常清晰的比赛计划，尤其是在控球时，并且拥有一些技术型球员。我们需要应对一些威胁，但我们可以利用我们的体力。”虽然哈德森强调了弗洛拉的威胁，但他相信我们在联赛中的成功可以给我们在欧洲带来推动。他说：“大多数男孩都在 CNG 效力，所以目前在 PL2 中处于不错的位置并且表现良好。我们可以将这种信心带入塔林。”随着队内信心的增强，哈德森渴望蓝军将这种势头带入爱沙尼亚。团结和防守去束缚将是我们明晚的关键。当球员们踏上球场时，CNG主帅表示他希望看到“有球和无球时的团结”。哈德森说：“我们正在进入一个不同的环境和不同的文化，所以我们需要在一起，成为一个团队，互相合作。 “这是一场危险程度很高的双回合平局，我们有优势在主场进行第二场比赛。我们的首要任务是尽可能做好防守，然后我们就知道我们拥有能够给任何球队带来真正问题的才华横溢的个人。”哈德森表示，本赛季到目前为止，我们在控球时的表现为我们的成功奠定了基础。他赞扬了球员们出色地执行了各种比赛计划。 CNG 经理表示：“我们有能力适应和管理威胁。如果一个团队从稍微不同的事情开始，我们可以通过建立一个可以灵活管理不同威胁的结构来解决这个问题。这为我们在过去六到八周的成功奠定了基础。”欧洲青年联赛是一项享有盛誉的赛事，为球员提供了在欧洲舞台上展示自己能力的绝佳机会。关于比赛提供的价值，哈德森说：“我们有球员将继续参加冠军联赛和所有欧洲比赛，因此这些青年联赛之旅让球员了解如何管理自己的日程安排和长途旅行。”对于这种经验和接触来说，这确实是无价的。 “我们围绕我们的团队身份举办了一次研讨会，并了解这是一场高危险的游戏，但我们有正确的属性来应对这种压力。青年联赛可能是世界上展示才华的最佳青年比赛，因此我们知道这项比赛可以给他们带来惊人的体验。”除了结果之外，哈德森希望看到蓝军以明确的身份进行比赛，并表现出作为一个团队的积极行为。开球前，他向球员们透露了最后的信息。 “我的最后一条信息可以追溯到团结一致、做好准备并为彼此努力。我们期待着不同的足球文化，并努力适应并在比赛中走上这条道路。

The experience includes champagne on arrival and four drinks per person: one speciality cocktail, with Bloody Marys, Spicy Margaritas and Sour Cherry Negronis on offer, plus three beers or glasses of wine from a selected list. Still and sparkling water, filter coffee and a soft drink are served for the table, while a live DJ builds the atmosphere ahead of kick-off. At 11.30am, guests will make the short journey to Stamford Bridge to take their seats in the East Stand middle tier for the Premier League fixture, with a half-time drinks voucher included. After the final whistle, the day continues with an hour of post-match hospitality in the Canoville Suite. Partnering with Hawksmoor enables us to offer something genuinely different for one of the biggest fixtures of the season, bringing together two of west London’s finest for a day our guests won’t forget.’ Places for the Club Chelsea and Hawksmoor matchday brunch are limited and available to book now by clicking here

news.title: OTD: Slick Chelsea hit City for six
news.title_zh: OTD：狡猾的切尔西六次击败曼城
news.body_en: Chelsea produced one of our most dominant wins of the Premier League era on 27 October 2007, brushing aside Sven Goran-Eriksson's Manchester City at Stamford Bridge. City arrived at the Bridge off the back of four consecutive victories, while the Blues were still coming to terms with the departure of Jose Mourinho a month earlier. Avram Grant was now in charge. Wins away to Bolton and Middlesbrough and at home to Schalke in the Champions League, all without conceding, suggested the Blues were finding some form. Against City, we ignited with a complete display from first to last. Michael Essien opened the scoring in the 16th minute with an accurate finish and we doubled our lead on the half-hour. A defence-splitting pass from Frank Lampard freed Didier Drogba to beat Joe Hart. Drogba added a third early in the second half and Joe Cole made it 4-0, finishing with aplomb after being released by the Ivorian. Salomon Kalou and sub Andriy Shevchenko converted passes from Essien as Chelsea blew a shellshocked City side away. 'We forgot how to defend,' admitted Eriksson afterwards. 'If you give a team like Chelsea space and time that will happen.' In truth, City were lucky it was only 6-0 by the time the final whistle blew, so dominant had Chelsea been.
news.body_zh: 2007 年 10 月 27 日，切尔西在斯坦福桥击败了斯文戈兰-埃里克森率领的曼城，取得了英超时代最具统治力的胜利之一。曼城在四连胜后抵达蓝桥，而蓝军仍在接受一个月前何塞·穆里尼奥的离开。阿夫拉姆·格兰特现在负责。在欧冠联赛中客场战胜博尔顿和米德尔斯堡，以及主场战胜沙尔克，全部不失球，表明蓝军正在寻找某种状态。对阵曼城的比赛，我们从始至终都展现出了完美的表现。迈克尔·埃辛在第 16 分钟以精准的射门首开纪录，半个小时后我们将领先优势扩大了一倍。弗兰克·兰帕德的一次突破防守的传球让迪迪埃·德罗巴摆脱了乔·哈特的束缚。德罗巴在下半场一开始就攻入第三球，乔·科尔在被科特迪瓦人释放后沉着地完成比赛，将比分改写为4-0。所罗门·卡劳和替补安德烈·舍甫琴科接应埃辛的传球，帮助切尔西击败了遭受炮轰的曼城。 “我们忘记了如何防守，”埃里克森事后承认。 “如果你给切尔西这样的球队空间和时间，这就会发生。”事实上，当终场哨声吹响时，曼城的战绩仅为6-0，这对曼城来说是幸运的，而切尔西则占据了如此大的统治地位。

news.title: Conversations open up as Menopause Matters event staged at Stamford Bridge
news.title_zh: 斯坦福桥举办“更年期问题”活动，对话展开
news.body_en: Earlier this month was World Menopause Day and ahead of the most recent Women’s Super League home game, a 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur, Chelsea FC Women and the club’s Women’s Empowerment Network hosted Menopause Matters at Stamford Bridge. As part of a wider focus on the seasons of womanhood, the event was designed to open up conversations around menopause, a natural stage of life that affects all women, yet is still too often misunderstood or overlooked. Hosted by broadcaster Cherry Healey, the session brought together an outstanding panel of experts and advocates, including women's health advocate Tina Backhouse, Michelle Griffith Robinson OLY, Dr Bal Sagoo and Carolyn Harris MP.‘Menopause affects 52% of the population and yet is often not discussed or well understood by women or healthcare professionals,’ noted Backhouse. ‘By having open discussions and sharing information at the event, stigmas and taboos are broken, meaning women will live longer in better health with better choices.’ Dr Sagoo added: ‘Life after 40? Be fabulous, not finished! Menopause may bring changes but with the right knowledge and support, you can take charge of your wellbeing and make your next chapter your best one yet.’ Through a combination of expert insights, personal perspectives and an interactive quiz, attending CFCW fans, club staff and industry guests explored how greater awareness and understanding can help create more supportive and inclusive environments for women at work, at home and in our communities. Harris explained why she was delighted to be asked to join the panel. ‘I am passionate about speaking to as many people – women and men – as I can to ensure that menopause knowledge is shared and the stigma is shattered. ‘Women don’t need special adjustments; we need information, we need understanding and we need respect. Menopause support, services and access to treatment are improving, and the more we talk openly and share knowledge, the more they will continue to improve. ‘The event at Chelsea was fantastic and I hope that those in the audience took away something that will help them personally or help them to better understand the women in their lives – be that at home or in the workplace.’ Healey, the host, gave an overall summary of the benefits of the gathering. ‘It’s so great to see that Chelsea are leading the way in opening up conversation around menopause and women’s health issues. Womanhood involves many changes that are totally normal but completely misunderstood due to a lack of awareness within our society. Events like this are so important for normalising the female experience and I’m so pleased to be part of it.’ The openness, engagement and willingness to share knowledge made for a genuinely impactful morning. These conversations matter. By continuing to increase awareness and understanding, we can help ensure that women feel supported through every stage of life. Chelsea Women partner Here We Flo gifted their products to attendees at the event.
news.body_zh: 本月早些时候是世界更年期日，在最近一场女足超级联赛主场比赛之前，切尔西女足以 6-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺，俱乐部的女性赋权网络在斯坦福桥举办了“更年期问题”活动。作为更广泛关注女性季节的一部分，该活动旨在开启有关更年期的对话，这是影响所有女性的一个自然阶段，但仍然经常被误解或忽视。该会议由广播公司 Cherry Healey 主持，汇聚了一批杰出的专家和倡导者，其中包括女性健康倡导者蒂娜·巴克豪斯 (Tina Backhouse)、米歇尔·格里菲斯·罗宾逊 (Michelle Griffith Robinson OLY)、巴尔·萨古 (Bal Sagoo) 博士和议员卡罗琳·哈里斯 (Carolyn Harris)。巴克豪斯指出，“更年期影响着 52% 的人口，但女性或医疗保健专业人员往往没有讨论或充分理解更年期。” “通过在活动中进行公开讨论和分享信息，耻辱和禁忌被打破，这意味着女性将拥有更好的选择，活得更久，更健康。”Sagoo 博士补充道：“40 岁以后的生活？”精彩，未完！更年期可能会带来变化，但有了正确的知识和支持，您可以掌控自己的健康，让您的下一章成为迄今为止最好的一章。”通过专家见解、个人观点和互动测验的结合，参加 CFCW 的粉丝、俱乐部工作人员和行业嘉宾探讨了如何提高认识和理解，帮助为女性在工作、家庭和社区创造更具支持性和包容性的环境。哈里斯解释了为什么她很高兴被邀请加入该小组。 “我热衷于与尽可能多的人——女性和男性——交谈，以确保分享更年期知识并打破耻辱。 “女性不需要特殊的调整；我们需要信息，我们需要理解，我们需要尊重。更年期支持、服务和获得治疗的机会正在改善，我们越公开讨论和分享知识，它们就会继续改善得越多。 “在切尔西举行的活动非常精彩，我希望观众能从中学到一些东西，对他们个人有帮助，或者帮助他们更好地了解生活中的女性——无论是在家里还是在工作场所。”主持人希利对这次聚会的好处进行了总体总结。 “很高兴看到切尔西带头开启有关更年期和女性健康问题的对话。女性身份涉及许多完全正常的变化，但由于我们社会缺乏认识，这些变化完全被误解了。像这样的活动对于女性体验的正常化非常重要，我很高兴能参与其中。”开放、参与和分享知识的意愿造就了一个真正有影响力的早晨。这些对话很重要。通过不断提高认识和理解，我们可以帮助确保女性在人生的每个阶段都感受到支持。切尔西女足合作伙伴 Here We Flo 向活动参加者赠送了她们的产品。

news.body_en: Chelsea's UEFA Women's Champions League campaign continues when Italian side Roma come to west London. The Blues remain unbeaten in continental competition this season after two matches of the league phase and will be looking to make it back-to-back home wins in the Champions League as European football returns to the top of the agenda in midweek. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Roma, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Roma takes place on Wednesday 28 October 2026 at Plough Lane, with kick-off scheduled for 5.45pm UK time. Tickets for the game remain on sale. If you can't make it to Plough Lane, then you can watch the match live on Disney+. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Roma Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea are yet to lose in this season's Champions League and have a 100 per cent record on home soil at Plough Lane. We opened our league phase campaign in west London with a 1-0 win over Austria Vienna, Wieke Kaptein getting the only goal of the game, before a goalless draw away at eight-time European champions Lyon last time out. Our opponents, on the other hand, come to these shores looking for their first win of the league phase, although they have won three in a row domestically in Serie A. In Europe, Roma started with a 0-0 draw against Leuven away in Belgium, but were then humbled by a 6-0 home defeat to Barcelona. Chelsea are hosting Roma in the league phase of the Champions League for the second season in a row, although last term's meeting at Stamford Bridge was the first-ever between these two sides. On that occasion it was a one-sided affair, with Kaptein, Johanna Rytting Kaneryd, Sjoeke Nusken, Maika Hamano and Lucy Bronze all getting on the scoresheet, after an own goal had given us the lead, in a 6-0 victory for the Blues. That was the only game Roma have ever played against English opposition, while Chelsea are unbeaten in five games against Italian teams, with fours wins and one draw, plus 15 goals scored to one against. We have never conceded at home to a Serie A side.

news.title: Chizaram Ezenwata signs new deal

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen forward Chizaram Ezenwata has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2029. Ezenwata joined Chelsea during his Under-15 year and quickly made an impression with his constant threat in attacking areas. He has been developed through the age groups of the Chelsea Academy, with his sharp footwork and clinical finishing among the standout features. Last season for the Under-18s, he enjoyed an outstanding season in front of goal, scoring 15 goals and providing seven assists in 21 matches. Now a regular in the CNG squad, Ezenwata made his Premier League 2 debut in 2024/25 against Manchester City. He continued to make an impact in the division, as well as for the Under-18s in 2025/26, which led to him being nominated for the Under-18 Premier League Player of the Season. His form has led to international recognition with England’s Young Lions. He represented England at the Under-17 World Cup in Qatar and scored a hat-trick in an 8-1 group-stage victory over Haiti. Most recently, he represented England during the September and October international window. The 18-year-old scored three goals in as many games for England Under-19s.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布科巴姆下一代前锋奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 签署了一份新合同，让他至少在俱乐部效力到 2029 年 6 月。埃森瓦塔 (Ezenwata) 在 U-15 赛季加入切尔西，并凭借在进攻领域持续的威胁很快给人留下了深刻的印象。他在切尔西青训营的各个年龄段中都得到了培养，其出色的脚法和冷静的射门能力是他的突出特点。上赛季，他在U-18队中表现出色，在21场比赛中打进15球并送出7次助攻。现在，埃森瓦塔是 CNG 队的主力球员，他在 2024/25 赛季对阵曼城的比赛中首次亮相英超 2 场比赛。他继续在联赛以及 2025/26 赛季的 U-18 联赛中发挥影响力，这使他被提名为本赛季 U-18 英超联赛最佳球员。他的表现赢得了英格兰幼狮队的国际认可。他代表英格兰参加了卡塔尔举行的U-17世界杯，并在小组赛8-1战胜海地的比赛中上演帽子戏法。最近，他代表英格兰队参加了九月和十月的国际比赛。这位 18 岁的球员在英格兰 U-19 队的比赛中打进了 3 个进球。

news.title: Bronze on Baltimore’s ‘magic’ and team desire proving decisive
news.title_zh: 巴尔的摩的“魔力”和团队渴望具有决定性作用，获得铜牌
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze was quick to praise Sandy Baltimore after the French international's starring role in Sunday’s Women’s Super League win at Crystal Palace, but believes it is Chelsea Women’s strength in depth across the pitch which is proving key this season. Despite difficult conditions as Storm Boelo battered Britain over the weekend, the Blues made their dominance tell by the final whistle, fighting back after falling behind against the run of play in the first half. Melvine Malard smashed in the equaliser from range, before heading us in front following tricky footwork by Baltimore. The three points were made safe late on, when Malard was brought down in the box, allowing Baltimore to make it 3-1 from the penalty spot and send Chelsea top of the WSL table. ‘It was bit of a tornado at times,’ admitted Bronze. ‘The conditions were a bit windy to say the least, but no excuses there. I think the quality and the desire as a team shined through in the end. ‘Palace put up a good fight, especially in the first half when the wind was with them. I don't think we're too happy with conceding from a corner, but just doing really well to get back into the game. ‘Obviously Sandy Baltimore came into the game and did what Sandy Baltimore does, her magic. I'm just happy with the result and the three points.’ Baltimore’s introduction came as one of two half-time substitutions by Sonia Bompastor as the Blues looked to chase the game and her impact was clear, particularly when beating a trio of defenders to tee up Malard to give us the lead for the first time in the game. ‘I thought that was one of the best moments, when we scored the second for Malard,’ Bronze continued. ‘I wasn't expecting it at all really. ‘It was made by having Sandy one v one – but she was actually one v three then – something that we all know that she's so good at. Give her the ball and she'll find a way to get it in the box and get around players. ‘But we have so many players that can come on and change a game. Erin [Cuthbert] as well has come on at half-time. We had new faces coming onto the pitch as well with Manaka [Matsukubo] and Giulia [Dragoni]. ‘So we're in a good place as a squad. We've got players available and we've been able to lift ourselves and have moments when we need them.’ For all the individual brilliance on display as we fought back to beat Crystal Palace, it is that depth of talent in the Chelsea squad which Bronze feels is proving to be most important during our strong start to the current campaign. ‘There's definitely a level of consistency that's followed through our games this year and I think last season, particularly in the second half of the season, we struggled a little bit with that. ‘It’s something that we've worked on really hard over pre-season. We have so much consistency across the pitch, no matter who's playing. We're really strong across every position, having two or three players, and just having that consistent mentality in every training session, every game, no matter who's playing or who's in the squad. ‘I think that's something that has changed a lot and that's the thing that will set us apart from some of the other teams this season.’ After six games played in the 2026/27 WSL, the Blues remain unbeaten and have won our last five. That sequence has taken us clear of Manchester City at the top of the table on goal difference after our rivals drew with Manchester United later on Sunday. ‘It's still quite early on in the season,’ Bronze concluded. ‘We've not even hit the halfway point. We just want to keep collecting our points, keep the pressure on ourselves more than anything. ‘The season's very long and it can change. Different teams will start to do well, momentum changes, but for us it's just about keeping the points coming so that we're always in contention to win the league.’
news.body_zh: 在周日女足超级联赛战胜水晶宫的比赛中法国国脚桑迪·巴尔的摩发挥出色后，露西·布朗兹很快就称赞了这位法国国脚，但她相信切尔西女足在球场上的深度实力才是本赛季的关键。尽管周末风暴博埃洛袭击了英国，但蓝军在上半场落后的情况下发起反击，在终场哨响时证明了自己的统治地位。梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 远距离扳平比分，随后巴尔的摩 (Baltimore) 巧妙的脚法为我们带来头球。最后，马拉德在禁区内被放倒，球队保全三分，巴尔的摩通过点球将比分改写为 3-1，切尔西在 WSL 积分榜上排名第一。 “有时有点像龙卷风，”布隆兹承认。 “至少可以说，天气有点大风，但没有任何借口。我认为作为一个团队的品质和愿望最终得到了体现。 “宫殿队打得很好，特别是在上半场顺风的时候。我不认为我们对角球失球感到太高兴，但我们做得很好，重新回到了比赛中。 “显然，桑迪·巴尔的摩进入了比赛，并做了桑迪·巴尔的摩所做的事情，她的魔力。我对结果和三分感到满意​​。”巴尔的摩的上场是索尼娅·邦帕斯特两次半场换人之一，蓝军希望追上比赛，她的影响力很明显，特别是在击败三名后卫为马拉德上球，让我们在比赛中第一次领先时。 “当我们为马拉德攻入第二球时，我认为那是最好的时刻之一，”布朗兹继续说道。 “我真的没想到会这样。 “这是由桑迪一对一制作的——但当时她实际上是一对三——我们都知道她非常擅长这一点。把球交给她，她就会找到一种方法将球送入禁区并绕过球员。 “但是我们有很多球员可以上场并改变比赛。艾琳（库斯伯特）也在中场休息时登场。我们也迎来了新面孔，包括马纳卡（松久保）和朱利亚（德拉戈尼）。 “所以我们作为一支球队处于一个很好的位置。我们有球员可以上场，我们能够振作起来，在我们需要他们的时候度过。”尽管我们在反击水晶宫的过程中展现出了个人的才华，但布朗泽认为，在我们本赛季的强劲开局中，切尔西队的天赋深度被证明是最重要的。 “今年我们的比赛肯定有一定程度的稳定性，我认为上赛季，特别是在赛季后半段，我们在这方面遇到了一些困难。 `这是我们在季前赛中非常努力的事情。无论谁在比赛，我们在球场上都有很强的稳定性。我们在每个位置上都非常强大，拥有两到三名球员，并且在每次训练、每场比赛中都保持一致的心态，无论谁在比赛或谁在队中。 “我认为这已经发生了很大的变化，这将使我们与本赛季其他一些球队区分开来。”在 2026/27 WSL 进行六场比赛后，蓝军保持不败，并赢得了最后五场比赛。在周日晚些时候我们的对手战平曼联后，这一顺序让我们以净胜球优势超越了积分榜榜首的曼城。 “现在还处于赛季初期，”布隆兹总结道。 “我们甚至还没有达到一半。我们只是想继续收集积分，给自己施加压力比什么都重要。 “这个赛季很长，而且可能会发生变化。不同的球队会开始表现出色，势头会发生变化，但对我们来说，这只是为了保持积分，这样我们就能一直争夺联赛冠军。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Decisive domestic action and European nights

news.body_en: A Carabao Cup trip to Anfield, European fixtures for Cobham Next Gen and Chelsea Women, and a Premier League meeting with Manchester United headline a busy seven days for the Blues. Here is everything to look out for at Chelsea this week… We begin the week by looking back at Chelsea Women's WSL victory at Crystal Palace, with highlights and reaction from Sonia Bompastor, Melvine Malard, Lexi Potter and Lucy Bronze. Attention will then turn to a packed week ahead, with both senior teams preparing for important fixtures in league and cup competitions. There will be a double helping of pre-match press conferences on Tuesday as both our head coaches look forward to midweek action. Xabi Alonso will face the media ahead of Chelsea's Carabao Cup fourth-round tie away at Liverpool, with the Blues looking to book our place in the next round of the competition. Sonia Bompastor will also speak to the media at 3pm, previewing Chelsea Women's UEFA Women's Champions League league-phase meeting with Roma. The Blues will be aiming to make home advantage count as European football returns to London. Earlier in the day, the first 15 minutes of training will be shown live from 12.30pm. Both press conferences will be available to watch on the Chelsea Official App and website, with the latest news and key updates available across our official channels. Cobham Next Gen’s UEFA Youth League campaign begins with a trip to Estonia to play Flora Tallinn in the first leg of our round two tie. Kick-off at the Lillekula Stadium is at 5pm, with the game being shown live on CFC+. It is also a European night for Chelsea Women as Roma visit the Cherry Red Records Stadium for a UEFA Women's Champions League encounter. Kick-off is at 5.45pm, and supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live updates in our Chelsea Women vs Roma Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. We will also bring you the latest reaction and post-match coverage after the final whistle. Later in the evening, the men's team travel to Merseyside for a Carabao Cup clash with Liverpool. The tie at Anfield kicks off at 8pm, as Alonso's side look to progress in a competition that has provided plenty of memorable moments throughout Chelsea's history. The match will be broadcast live on ITV and Sky Sports in the UK. Supporters can also follow the action with minute-by-minute updates and live commentary in our Liverpool vs Chelsea Match Centre. Our focus turns to the weekend as preparations continue at Cobham. Following Wednesday's cup action, we will bring you the latest from both senior squads as the men's team prepare for Manchester United's visit to Stamford Bridge and Chelsea Women get ready for another London derby. There will also be a chance to catch up on the best of the action from our midweek fixtures, including highlights and reaction from Anfield and Chelsea Women's European encounter with Roma. Both head coaches will return to the press conference room as the weekend build-up gathers pace. Alonso will preview Saturday's Premier League meeting with Manchester United, while Bompastor will address the media at 3pm ahead of Sunday's WSL trip to Charlton Athletic. We will bring you the latest team news, the managers' thoughts and all the key talking points from both press conferences on the Chelsea Official App and website. The men's team take centre stage at Stamford Bridge as Manchester United visit for a Premier League encounter. Kick-off is at 12.30pm, with the Blues looking to bounce back in the league after the defeat to Tottenham ended our winning run. Supporters can follow all the build-up, team news and live action in our Chelsea vs Manchester United Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. We will provide minute-by-minute updates, live commentary and post-match reaction, alongside the best photographs and highlights from the Bridge. Earlier on Saturday, there is Academy action as Chelsea Under-18s travel to face West Ham United in the Under-18 Premier League. Kick-off is at 11am and supporters who have subscribed to CFC+ can watch the game live on our channels. We round off the week with another London derby as Chelsea Women travel to The Valley to take on Charlton Athletic in the Women's Super League. Bompastor's side kick off at 2.30pm, looking to build on their midweek European outing with a strong domestic performance against the newly-promoted hosts. The match will be shown live on BBC Two in the UK, while our Charlton Athletic vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website will provide all the latest team news, live updates and reaction. We will also bring you the best of the action from Saturday's meeting with Manchester United and our Under-18s' trip to West Ham, ensuring you can catch up on everything happening across the club as another busy week comes to a close.

news.title: Melvine Malard on half-time wake-up call and love for Baltimore
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）中场休息时的警钟和对巴尔的摩的热爱
news.body_en: Melvine Malard described the striker’s instinct that saw her fire in a brace in our 3-1 win against Crystal Palace on Sunday, but also explained how the team needed a jolt at half-time to spark the comeback. The Eagles took the lead from a corner after 20 minutes, which meant we trailed at half-time for the first time this season. It took just five minutes after the restart for Malard to net her first of the afternoon and then she headed in from second-half substitute Sandy Baltimore’s cross 25 minutes later. The number nine then won a penalty in the final stages of the match, which Baltimore scored to complete the 3-1 victory. With the three points successfully in the bag, Malard explained how the team reacted in the dressing room at the interval. ‘It was so good to win today because it was a hard game with the wind,’ she explained. ‘But the team could keep going and put the energy into this game. ‘We said “wake up” at half time because it wasn’t a very good start to the game, but we know our quality; we know the way we needed to play to win the game. When we came back out in the second half, we showed that quality.’ Malard shot wide of the target right before she scored from 25 yards out, and she explained how that missed opportunity spurred her on to shoot from distance. ‘I was really in the action before when I missed, and so I knew my touch was good,’ she said. ‘I told myself to shoot and that’s what I did. I am in a good place. This is a seriously good team, and we have good staff.’ Malard paid tribute to Baltimore for a superb second-half display after the pair combined on both the second and third goals against Palace. ‘I love her,’ the striker beamed. ‘She has a lot of quality to go 1-v-1, and as a striker, you only need to go in the box, and she can give you the ball. She showed that today when she came in to help the team. ‘We will take the energy we put in today to the Roma game on Wednesday. We scored three goals today, so that is good. We will keep going to score the goals.’
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德描述了这位前锋在周日 3-1 战胜水晶宫的比赛中梅开二度的直觉，同时也解释了球队如何需要在半场休息时振作起来，以引发逆转。 20分钟后老鹰队通过角球取得领先，这意味着我们本赛季第一次在半场落后。比赛重新开始后仅五分钟，马拉德就攻入了下午的第一个进球，25 分钟后，她接到下半场替补桑迪·巴尔的摩的传中头球破门。随后，9号球员在比赛最后阶段获得点球，巴尔的摩队最终以3-1获胜。成功拿下三分后，马拉德在中场休息时解释了球队在更衣室的反应。 “今天获胜真是太好了，因为这是一场艰难的比赛，风很大，”她解释道。 “但是球队可以继续前进，并将精力投入到这场比赛中。 “我们在中场休息时说‘醒来’，因为这不是一个很好的比赛开局，但我们知道我们的实力；我们知道我们需要采取什么方式来赢​​得比赛。当我们在下半场扳回一城时，我们展现出了这样的实力。”马拉德在 25 码外射门之前射门偏出目标，她解释了这次错失的机会如何促使她进行远射。 “之前当我失手的时候，我真的很投入，所以我知道我的手感很好，”她说。 “我告诉自己要开枪，我就这么做了。我处于一个好地方。这是一支非常优秀的球队，我们有优秀的员工。”在对阵水晶宫队的第二个和第三个进球后，马拉德对巴尔的摩下半场的出色表现表示敬意。 “我爱她，”前锋微笑着说。 “她有很强的一对一能力，作为一名前锋，你只需要进入禁区，她就能把球传给你。今天当她进来帮助球队时，她就证明了这一点。 `我们将把今天投入的精力带到周三对阵罗马的比赛中。今天我们进了三个球，这很好。我们将继续进球。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on Malard 'banger' and second-half turnaround
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特谈马拉德的“猛击”和下半场的逆转
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor explained how the weather made things difficult for Chelsea away at Crystal Palace on Sunday, but hailed the quality of French duo Melvine Malard and Sandy Baltimore for our second-half turnaround. The Blues went in at the break 1-0 down after the home side netted from a corner, but a brace from Malard plus a late penalty from substitute Baltimore secured a 3-1 win despite the initial setback. Our head coach explained exactly how we reversed the deficit in tricky circumstances and gave insight into what she said at half-time to galvanise the side. ‘The weather was not helpful today,’ she said. ‘Especially for a team like us who like to play on the ground, it didn't help. We probably didn't create as much as I would have liked to in the first half. ‘The second half was a better performance. We played more with the wind, which helped a little bit as well. The quality of the players who came in was good again, and they brought the impact we needed to win the game. ‘We needed to stay confident in these moments. It's really important to stay calm, even if the result is not in our hands and the weather is not helpful. I knew in the second half we had enough quality to create and to score some goals. ‘The message was around adjusting some of the defensive aspects a little but also giving the players a lot of confidence with the ball. I wanted us to keep trying, because I knew we would have opportunities, and in those moments we were clinical.’ Malard would’ve scored a hat-trick had her third goal not been ruled offside on Sunday afternoon, and it was the number nine that won the penalty on 88 minutes. Baltimore created the assist for Malard’s second and converted the spot-kick at the end of the game, leaving Bompastor full of praise for her compatriots. ‘The French players showed up today, and it was really needed,’ the head coach continued. ‘I'm happy for them, especially Sandy. She hasn't had a lot of minutes recently, but that was the best answer she could give to me. Her performance was really good. ‘When you play a team that is sitting more in the low block, she brings a lot of quality on crosses, but also on the ball, and she can beat her opponent one-on-one. That was a big help today. ‘I wasn't expecting Melvine to score from distance like that. It's a banger, as you say here! She has the ability to create those goals. She's an important player for us and I'm glad for her that she scored a really difficult goal. She could have scored an easy one just before. It makes things even better for her, and scoring like that is always good for her confidence.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了周日客场对阵水晶宫的比赛中天气如何给切尔西造成了困难，但她对法国二人组梅尔文·马拉德和桑迪·巴尔的摩在下半场扭转局面的表现表示赞赏。中场休息时，主队角球破门，蓝军以 1-0 落后，但马拉德梅开二度，再加上替补出场的巴尔的摩在最后时刻的点球，尽管最初遭遇挫折，但蓝军还是以 3-1 获胜。我们的主教练准确地解释了我们如何在棘手的情况下逆转比分，并深入分析了她在半场时所说的话，以激励球队。 “今天的天气不太好，”她说。 “特别是对于像我们这样喜欢在地面上比赛的球队来说，这没有帮助。上半场我们可能没有创造出我想要的那么多。 ‘下半场表现更好。我们更多地利用风，这也有一点帮助。上场球员的素质再次出色，他们为我们带来了赢得比赛所需的影响。 “在这些时刻我们需要保持信心。保持冷静非常重要，即使结果不在我们手中并且天气也无济于事。我知道下半场我们有足够的实力来创造机会并取得一些进球。 “传达的信息是对一些防守方面进行一些调整，但同时也让球员对球充满信心。我希望我们继续努力，因为我知道我们会有机会，在那些时刻我们都很冷静。如果周日下午马拉德的第三个进球没有被判越位，她本可以上演帽子戏法，而正是第 9 号球员在第 88 分钟赢得了点球。巴尔的摩队为马拉德送出第二次助攻，并在比赛结束时主罚点球，让邦帕斯特对她的同胞们赞不绝口。 “法国球员今天出现了，这确实是需要的，”主教练继续说道。 “我为他们感到高兴，尤其是桑迪。她最近没有太多时间，但这是她能给我的最好答案。她的表演真的很好。 “当你对阵一支更多地坐在低​​位的球队时，她在传中和控球方面都带来了很大的质量，她可以一对一地击败对手。这对今天来说是一个很大的帮助。 “我没想到梅尔文能像那样远距离得分。正如你在这里所说的，这是一个香肠！她有能力创造这些目标。她对我们来说是一位重要的球员，我为她感到高兴，因为她打进了一个非常困难的进球。之前她本可以轻松得分。这让她的情况变得更好，这样的得分总是有利于她的信心。”

news.title: Match report: Crystal Palace 1-3 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：水晶宫 1-3 切尔西女足
news.body_en: A brace from Melvine Malard and a penalty scored by Sandy Baltimore ensured Chelsea recovered from a subpar first half to secure a 3-1 victory away at Crystal Palace. The sun came out on Sunday for our trip to south London after Saturday's torrential rain, but the howling wind wasn't conducive to stroking the ball around on the floor. For all of Chelsea's good work in the opening quarter-of-an-hour, it was the home side who took the lead when Molly Bartrip bundled the ball home from a corner after 20 minutes. Sonia Bompastor's team talk must've had an impact as the Blues emerged with a renewed focus after the break as Malard levelled the scores on 50 minutes with a stunning effort from the edge of the box. The match once again became tight as Palace attempted to preserve the point, but some determined work from substitute Baltimore on the left wing gave her the space to serve up an opportunity on a plate for Malard to head in her second of the afternoon. Baltimore then got herself on the scoresheet when she converted a late penalty after Malard was fouled in the box, ensuring we finished the day on a positive note after our first-half struggles. Bompastor made two alterations to her starting line-up ahead of this fixture, rotating Keira Walsh and Lauren James out of the side in place of Sjoeke Nusken and Maika Hamano. Meanwhile, Manaka Matsukubo made the squad for the first time since joining Chelsea in the summer from North Carolina Courage. The game began with the Blues pushing forward to make an immediate impact, with Alyssa Thompson causing problems for the home side down the left-hand channel and Ellie Carpenter linking up well with central striker Malard on the right. Our first real opportunity of the match came in the 14th minute, when Hamano saw her shot palmed away by the goalkeeper before Malard's shot was cleared off the line by the Palace defence. The strong winds in Sutton were always going to play a part in this contest, and made set-pieces more dangerous for both sides. When Palace swung in their second corner of the match, defender Bartrip popped up at the back post to steer the ball through the resulting melee and into the bottom corner of the net. Chelsea attempted to hit back through a Nusken power drive from inside the penalty area, but Pauline Peyraud-Magnin was able to quickly get low to snuff out the danger. Bompastor made two changes at the break, exchanging Hamano and Thompson for Erin Cuthbert and Baltimore. We showed our attacking intent when Malard went close within minutes of the restart, and it was the French international who got us back on level terms shortly afterwards. Receiving the ball 25 yards from goal from a Katie McCabe throw-in, Malard found herself in space and unleashed a stunning strike that fizzed past a helpless Peyraud-Magnin. But determined Palace were keen to fight back, and there was a let-off when former Blues striker Bethany England got herself into a good position to shoot but blazed her attempt over the bar. Our second goal of the afternoon saw Malard net her brace, but the chance was created solely by Baltimore. Driving towards the box, she sped between two Palace defenders before evading the challenge of a third and making it to the by-line to deliver a looping ball straight to the head of Malard, who wasted no time in nodding the ball home. Our noses were finally in front with 15 minutes to play, and Malard could've had her hat-trick soon afterwards but was denied by the offside flag after taking a slight touch on a brilliant ball in from McCabe. As the home side began to tire, Nusken was unlucky not to get on the scoresheet when she hit the woodwork, and with 88 minutes on the clock the French duo were decisive once again when we were awarded a penalty. Malard won the spot-kick when she was fouled inside the box, and after the number nine received some brief treatment, the ball was passed to Baltimore. The substitute stepped up and converted, securing the points after an excellent second-half display. There was to be one more positive before the final whistle, too, as Matsukubo was handed her Chelsea debut when she was introduced on 90 minutes. This was another resilient performance from the Blues, as we recorded our sixth win from seven WSL games so far this season. We go top of the WSL table, pending Manchester City's result later on. We return to Women's Champions League action when we take on Roma at Plough Lane at 5.45pm on Wednesday. Chelsea: Hampton, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Buchanan, McCabe, Nusken (Dragoni 90), Potter, Kaptein (Beever-Jones 69), Thompson (Baltimore h/t), Hamano (Cuthbert h/t), Malard (Matsukubo 90)Unused substitutes: Peng, Buurman, Las, BrownScorers: Malard 50, 75, Baltimore 90Booked: Kaptein 44, McCabe 44, Bronze 63 Crystal Palace: Peyraud-Magnin, Everett (c), Lloyd-Smith, England, Ladd (Enge 90+5), Blanchard, Larkin, Goldie, Tsunoda, Swaby (Napier 90+5), BartripUnused subs: Yanez, Sharpe, Howat, Weerden, Nolan, Hopcroft, O'BrienScorers: Bartrip 20Booked: Blanchard 44, Ladd 70Referee: Alice Parker
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德的梅开二度和桑迪·巴尔的摩的点球帮助切尔西从上半场的低迷状态中恢复过来，客场3-1战胜水晶宫。周六的暴雨过后，周日太阳出来了，我们前往伦敦南部旅行，但呼啸的风不利于在地板上抚摸球。尽管切尔西在开场一刻钟表现出色，但 20 分钟后莫莉·巴特里普 (Molly Bartrip) 从角球将球射入球门，主队取得了领先。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的团队讲话一定产生了影响，蓝军在中场休息后重新集中注意力，马拉德在禁区边缘的一脚惊人射门在第 50 分钟扳平了比分。比赛再次变得胶着，水晶宫试图保住这一分，但替补上场的巴尔的摩在左翼的顽强拼搏为她提供了空间，为马拉德在下午的第二场比赛中头球破门。马拉德在禁区内被犯规后，巴尔的摩队在最后时刻罚进点球，取得了进球，确保我们在上半场的挣扎之后以积极的姿态结束这一天。博姆帕斯特在这场比赛之前对首发阵容进行了两次调整，将凯拉·沃尔什和劳伦·詹姆斯轮换出首发阵容，代替舍克·努斯肯和麦卡·滨野。与此同时，自今年夏天从北卡罗来纳勇气队加盟切尔西以来，松久保真中首次入选大名单。比赛一开始，蓝军就立即发起进攻，阿丽莎·汤普森在左路给主队制造了麻烦，而埃莉·卡彭特则与右侧的中锋马拉德配合得很好。我们本场比赛的第一个真正的机会出现在第 14 分钟，当时滨野看到她的射门被门将挡出，随后马拉德的射门被水晶宫后卫挡出了底线。萨顿的强风总是会在这场比赛中发挥作用，并使双方的定位球变得更加危险。当水晶宫开出第二个角球时，后卫巴特里普突然出现在后门柱处，引导球穿过由此产生的混战，进入球网下角。切尔西试图通过禁区内的努斯肯强力反击进行反击，但宝琳·佩罗-马格宁迅速压低身位，化解了危险。邦帕斯托在中场休息时做出了两次换人，将哈野野和汤普森换成了艾琳·库斯伯特和巴尔的摩。当马拉德在比赛重新开始后几分钟内逼近时，我们展现了我们的进攻意图，不久之后正是这位法国国脚让我们扳平了比分。马拉德在距离球门 25 码处接到凯蒂·麦凯布的界外球后，发现自己处于空位，并射出一脚惊人的射门，飞过了无助的佩罗-马宁。但意志坚定的水晶宫渴望反击，前蓝军前锋贝瑟尼·英格兰找到了一个良好的射门位置，但射门高出横梁，导致了一次失误。我们下午的第二个进球是马拉德梅开二度，但这个机会完全是由巴尔的摩创造的。她冲向禁区，在两名水晶宫后卫之间快速穿行，然后躲避了第三名后卫的挑战，并到达边线，将一记弧线球直接传到马拉德的头上，马拉德毫不犹豫地将球打进了球门。比赛还剩 15 分钟时，我们的比分终于领先，马拉德本可以很快上演帽子戏法，但在接住麦凯布的精彩传球后，被越位旗挡出。当主队开始疲倦时，努斯肯不幸击中门框而未能取得进球，在比赛还剩88分钟时，这对法国组合再次发挥了决定性作用，我们获得了点球。马拉德在禁区内被犯规，赢得了点球，9号球员经过短暂治疗后，球传给了巴尔的摩。下半场替补球员上场并完成转换，凭借出色的表现锁定了积分。终场哨响之前还有一个积极的事情，松久保在第 90 分钟上场时完成了切尔西的处子秀。这是蓝军的又一次坚韧表现，本赛季迄今为止，我们在七场 WSL 比赛中取得了第六场胜利。我们在 WSL 积分榜上名列前茅，等待曼城稍后的结果。周三下午 5 点 45 分，我们将回到女子冠军联赛的比赛中，我们将在 Plough Lane 迎战罗马。 切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、麦凯布、努斯肯（德拉戈尼 90）、波特、卡普坦（比弗-琼斯 69）、汤普森（巴尔的摩主队）、滨野（卡斯伯特主队）、马拉德（松久保 90）未上场替补：彭、布尔曼、拉斯、布朗得分手：马拉德 50、75、巴尔的摩 90 黄牌：卡普坦 44、麦凯布 44、铜牌 63 水晶宫：佩罗-马格宁、埃弗雷特（队长）、劳埃德-史密斯、英格兰、拉德（恩格 90+5）、布兰查德、拉金、戈尔迪、角田、斯瓦比（纳皮尔 90+5）、巴特里普未上场替补：亚内兹、夏普、霍瓦特、韦尔登、诺兰、霍普克罗夫特、奥布莱恩记分员：巴特里普 20 黄牌：布兰查德 44，拉德 70 裁判：爱丽丝·帕克

news.title: Lacroix: ‘We must show the reaction of a competitor’
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦：“我们必须展示竞争对手的反应”
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix is looking to our forthcoming games against Liverpool and Manchester United as an opportunity to put things right after our loss to Tottenham. The Blues were beaten 2-0 at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, putting an abrupt end to our promising recent results. However, there is a chance to hit back in the best way possible by defeating two longstanding rivals, starting with our Carabao Cup fourth round trip to Anfield in midweek. ‘It’s a big game for us,’ said Lacroix. ‘We want to go far in this competition and it’s good that we have a game like this now. We have to move on and work on some details to be stronger in certain moments and change some situations. ‘We have to show the reaction of a competitor. We want to show another face, we want to win there, and it’s going to be a big game.’ Lacroix also offered support to Mike Penders, whose own goal gave Tottenham the lead on his first Premier League start. Xabi Alonso has confirmed the Belgian will start at Anfield on Wednesday, and Lacroix explained how the group will offer support to Penders ahead of that trip. ‘He is a young goalkeeper and he has a lot of talent,’ said Lacroix. ‘He will learn from this. This can happen in football careers and in life, everyone makes mistakes, and we have to be with him and we are going to be with him. We are behind him. He will help us this season and now we have to help him.’
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix）将接下来对阵利物浦和曼联的比赛视为在输给托特纳姆热刺后扭转局面的机会。周六，蓝军在斯坦福桥被 2-0 击败，为我们近期的希望之战画上句号。然而，我们有机会以最好的方式进行反击，击败两个长期对手，从周中前往安菲尔德的卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛开始。 “这对我们来说是一场重要的比赛，”拉克鲁瓦说。 “我们希望在这场比赛中走得更远，很高兴我们现在有这样的比赛。我们必须继续前进，在一些细节上努力，以便在某些时刻变得更强并改变某些情况。 “我们必须展示竞争对手的反应。我们想要展示另一张面孔，我们想要在那里获胜，这将是一场重要的比赛。”拉克鲁瓦还向迈克·潘德斯表示支持，他的乌龙球让托特纳姆热刺队在他的第一次英超首发中取得了领先。哈维·阿隆索已经确认比利时人将于周三在安菲尔德首发，拉克鲁瓦解释了该团队将如何在那次旅行之前为彭德斯提供支持。 “他是一名年轻的门将，而且很有天赋，”拉克鲁瓦说。 ‘他将从中吸取教训。这可能发生在足球生涯和生活中，每个人都会犯错误，我们必须和他在一起，我们也会和他在一起。我们在他身后。他将在这个赛季帮助我们，现在我们必须帮助他。”

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Crystal Palace
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西女足对阵水晶宫的阵容
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made two changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Super League match away at Crystal Palace. The Blues are coming off a 6-2 win over Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge last weekend and now face another test in the WSL against the newly-promoted Eagles. Bompastor has switched Keira Walsh for Sjoeke Nusken, while Maika Hamano – who scored a wonder goal against Spurs – comes in for Lauren James. Lexi Potter starts against the team where she spent two seasons on loan. She helped Palace earn promotion to the WSL in 2023/24 and returned to spend a full campaign in the top flight the following year. And after completing her recovery from injury and scoring a hat-trick for the Under-18s last weekend, summer signing Manaka Matsukubo is named on the bench for the first time this season. news.title: Caicedo: 'Everybody knows what we need to improve'
news.title_zh: 凯塞多：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”
news.body_en: Moises Caicedo didn’t search for excuses in his post-match media duties after our defeat to Tottenham Hotspur. And his message was clear: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve’. The Blues entered yesterday’s game at Stamford Bridge after back-to-back top-flight wins that had seen Bournemouth and then Everton convincingly beaten. We had also not tasted defeat on home soil this season. As Xabi Alonso accepted after the game, we were not at our best across the 90 minutes. Yet we did create chances. Cole Palmer, Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto all tested Antonin Kinsky in the opening period. Yet in a tight second half, Tottenham broke the deadlock by forcing an own goal from Mike Penders following a corner. Mathys Tel then netted late on to seal the win, with the Blues down to ten men after Cole Palmer was sent off. Caicedo, who wore the captain’s armband, was naturally disappointed with the result and accepted the Blues must learn from the painful defeat. He said: ‘We need to be focused during the whole game because if you switch off for one second, you get punished. ‘We need to learn from this because we need to stop this from happening and we need to maintain the clean sheet for the whole game. ‘It was a tough one, but we need to keep going because there are more games in front of us and we want to do better.’ The Ecuadorian midfielder added: ‘Everybody knows what we need to improve. We are going to think about this game because we need to be up there in the table.  We need to learn from this and for sure we are going to be up there [at the end of the season].’ For Caicedo, the game saw his third start in succession after overcoming an early-season injury. The 24-year-old was impressive in the middle of the pitch, winning a game-high four interceptions and making two tackles. ‘I tried to do my best and help the team and for sure I’m feeling better game by game,’ he explained. ‘This one was a tough game but I want to keep doing well and improving what I need to improve because I want to be someone that helps the team in every moment.’
news.body_zh: 在我们输给托特纳姆热刺队后，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并没有在他的赛后媒体职责中寻找借口。他的信息很明确：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么”。蓝军在连续两场顶级联赛胜利后进入了昨天在斯坦福桥的比赛，其中伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿都被令人信服地击败。本赛季我们在主场也没有尝到失败的滋味。正如哈维·阿隆索赛后承认的那样，我们在 90 分钟内并没有处于最佳状态。但我们确实创造了机会。科尔·帕尔默、乔丹·亨德森、摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托都在开场阶段考验了安东尼·金斯基。然而，在紧张的下半场，托特纳姆热刺队在角球后迫使迈克·彭德斯自摆乌龙，打破了僵局。马蒂斯·特尔随后在最后时刻进球锁定胜局，在科尔·帕尔默被罚下场后，蓝军的人数减少至十人。戴上队长袖标的凯塞多自然对结果感到失望，并认为蓝军必须从惨痛的失败中吸取教训。他说：“我们需要在整场比赛中保持专注，因为如果你停顿一秒钟，你就会受到惩罚。 “我们需要从中吸取教训，因为我们需要阻止这种情况发生，我们需要保持整场比赛不失球。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我们需要继续前进，因为我们面前还有更多比赛，我们想要做得更好。”这位厄瓜多尔中场补充道：“每个人都知道我们需要改进什么。”我们会考虑这场比赛，因为我们需要在积分榜上名列前茅。  我们需要从中吸取教训，并且确信我们将在赛季末达到目标。”对于凯塞多来说，这场比赛是他在克服赛季初伤病后连续第三次首发。这位24岁的球员在球场中场的表现令人印象深刻，赢得了全场最高的四次拦截并完成了两次铲球。 “我尽力做到最好，帮助球队，当然我每一场比赛都感觉更好，”他解释道。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，但我想继续表现出色，并改进我需要改进的地方，因为我想成为每时每刻都能帮助球队的人。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on his confidence in Mike Penders and Liverpool decision
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索对迈克·彭德斯和利物浦的决定充满信心
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has emphasised his Chelsea team ‘win and lose together’ and reaffirmed his confidence in Mike Penders, who the Blues manager confirmed will start against Liverpool in the Carabao Cup. The Belgian goalkeeper made his first Premier League start in yesterday’s game against Tottenham Hotspur and produced impressive first-half stops to deny Omar Marmoush and Mathys Tel. Unfortunately, in the second period, an own goal from Penders under pressure from Jan Paul van Hecke enabled Tottenham to take the lead. It was one of the visitors doubled late on to claim a rare win at Stamford Bridge. Alonso stressed the importance of everyone learning and improving following the defeat, including our 21-year-old goalkeeper. ‘It’s part of the business; you need to deal with mistakes and we keep confidence in Mike and he will be in goal against Liverpool,' the Blues manager said. ‘We win and we lose together and it’s part of the job to deal with mistakes, myself as well as everyone. ‘We support Mike and Geo (Quenda) as well, the guys starting their first [Premier League] games. He will want to prove he can do better - and we also have to show that.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索强调他的切尔西队“赢和输在一起”，并重申了他对迈克·潘德斯的信心，蓝军主教练确认他将在卡拉宝杯对阵利物浦的比赛中首发。这位比利时门将在昨天对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中首次在英超联赛中首发，并在上半场做出了令人印象深刻的扑救，挡出了奥马尔·马尔穆什和马蒂斯·特尔的射门。不幸的是，第二节，潘德斯在范赫克的压力下打进乌龙球，帮助热刺取得领先。这是其中一支客队在最后时刻加倍，在斯坦福桥取得了一场罕见的胜利。阿隆索强调了失败后每个人学习和进步的重要性，包括我们 21 岁的门将。 “这是业务的一部分；你需要处理错误，我们对迈克保持信心，他将在对阵利物浦的比赛中进球，”蓝军主帅说道。 “我们一起赢，一起输，处理错误是工作的一部分，无论是我自己还是每个人。 “我们也支持迈克和吉奥（奎恩达），他们开始了他们的第一场[英超]比赛。他想要证明自己可以做得更好——我们也必须证明这一点。

news.title: Premier League 2 report: Cobham Next Gen 2-2 Liverpool
news.title_zh: 英超联赛 2 报告：科巴姆下一代 2-2 利物浦
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen were forced to settle for a point in Premier League 2 this afternoon after a 2-2 draw against Liverpool at Kingsmeadow. Harrison McMahon broke the deadlock inside two minutes with a powerful finish into the bottom corner. Sol Gordon then added to the scoreline midway through the opening period with a first-time strike beyond Harvey Davies to put the Blues in control. Minutes later, though, we were pegged back as Will Wright made it 2-1. Although we went in ahead at the break, Liverpool scored another early in the second half through a Jayden Danns free-kick. Both sides pushed for a late winner, but the spoils were shared. Chelsea set the tone immediately, scoring within two minutes through McMahon. Chizaram Ezenwata picked up the ball centrally and turned before playing a pass into McMahon’s path, and the midfielder made no mistake with his low-driven strike across goal. Ezenwata, who claimed the assist for the opener, caused the Liverpool’s backline constant problems, getting on the ball in deep areas and driving forwards. He wasn’t far away from doubling our lead when he found half a yard on Reds defender Talla Ndiaye, but his effort went just wide. Our speed constantly caused issues for the visitors' defence, with Mathis Eboue and Gordon enjoying plenty of success down the flanks. It was the latter who doubled our advantage, finishing a well-worked move. Ezenwata held the ball up well and forced his marker to bring him down. That enabled Kendry Paez to emerge with the ball and burst forward. Just as Ecuadorian looked like he was going to shoot, he instead chopped inside onto his right foot and selflessly passed to Gordon, who dispatched a fine finish past Davies. Five minutes after Gordon scored, Wright pulled one back for the visitors, capitalising on their only meaningful chance of the half. After the break, Liverpool pulled themselves back level with Danns converting from a free-kick. He placed his strike into the bottom corner, beyond the outstretched glove of Freddy Bernal. Liverpool continued to put us under pressure, with Prince Cisse hitting the post and Oliver O'Connor missing a clear-cut chance. We pushed for a late winner but were ultimately forced to settle for a point. After six games, this draw leaves us on 13 points in Premier League 2 and in second position. The league leaders are ahead via goal difference with a game in hand. Cobham Next Gen are kickstart their UEFA Youth League campaign on Wednesday 28 October, when we face Estonian side Flora Tallinn at the Lillekula Stadium. The game gets underway at 5pm BST and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 切尔西科巴姆下一代队今天下午在金斯梅多 2-2 战平利物浦后，被迫在英超第二轮比赛中获得一分。哈里森·麦克马洪在两分钟内就以一记强力射门打破了僵局。随后，索尔·戈登在开场中段首次进球，超越哈维·戴维斯，帮助蓝军掌控局势。但几分钟后，我们被追平，威尔·赖特将比分改写为 2-1。尽管我们在中场休息时取得领先，但利物浦在下半场一开始就通过杰登·丹斯的任意球再次进球。双方都力争最后的胜利，但战利品是共享的。切尔西立即定下了基调，两分钟内就通过麦克马洪进球。奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔（Chizaram Ezenwata）在中路接球转身，然后将球传给麦克马洪（McMahon）的路径，这位中场球员的低射门没有失误。首场比赛助攻的埃森瓦塔给利物浦的后防线带来了持续的麻烦，他在后场接球并向前推进。当他发现红军后卫塔拉·恩迪亚耶半码处时，距离将我们的领先优势扩大一倍不远了，但他的射门稍稍偏出。我们的速度不断给客队的防守带来问题，马蒂斯·埃布和戈登在侧翼取得了很多成功。正是后者将我们的优势扩大了一倍，完成了一场精心策划的行动。埃森瓦塔（Ezenwata）很好地控住了球，并迫使他的盯防者将他放倒。这使得肯德利·佩兹能够持球并向前冲锋。正当厄瓜多尔人看上去要射门时，他右脚内切，无私地传给戈登，戈登以一记漂亮的射门越过了戴维斯。戈登进球五分钟后，赖特为客队扳回一球，利用了他们半场唯一一次有意义的机会。中场休息后，丹斯任意球破门，利物浦将比分扳平。他将球射入底角，超出了弗雷迪·伯纳尔伸出的手套。利物浦继续给我们带来压力，西塞王子击中门柱，奥利弗·奥康纳错失了一次绝佳的机会。我们力争最后获胜，但最终被迫只得一分。六场比赛过后，这场平局让我们在英超联赛第二名中积 13 分，排名第二。联赛领头羊在少赛一场的情况下以净胜球优势领先。科巴姆下一代队将于 10 月 28 日星期三开始他们的欧洲青年联赛，届时我们将在利勒库拉体育场迎战爱沙尼亚球队弗洛拉塔林。比赛将于英国夏令时下午 5 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（3-4-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔；阿尔菲·奥斯本、贾斯汀·奥萨吉、塔约·苏布洛耶；哈里森·麦克马洪、雷吉·沃森、肯德利·佩兹（哈里森·贝托尼 81）、利奥·布莱克；索尔·戈登、奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔、马蒂斯·埃布埃（里奥·卡多佐 65）未上场替补：杰克·奥斯汀、莱利·埃博、丹特·维特、卡尔文·迪亚基特、易卜拉欣·拉巴杰进球者：哈里森·麦克马洪 2、索尔·戈登 20 黄牌：贾斯汀·奥萨吉 63、阿尔菲·奥斯本 73 利物浦（4-3-3）：哈维·戴维斯；西塞王子、卢卡斯·皮特、Wellity Lucky、塔拉·恩迪亚耶；本·特鲁曼（约瑟夫·厄普顿 69 分钟）、迈克尔·拉菲（中）、约书亚·兰比（丹尼尔·奥纳努加 69 分钟）；奥利弗·奥康纳、杰登·丹斯（约瑟夫·布拉德肖 69’）、威尔·赖特未上场替补：贝利·霍尔、阿尔文·艾曼、瑞安·考利、帕特里克·法卡斯进球球员：威尔·赖特 25、杰登·丹斯

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Tottenham defeat: 'We all take the blame'
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈托特纳姆热刺失利：“我们都承担责任”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was disappointed with the performance and result against Tottenham Hotspur and accepted his Chelsea side 'can do better' after succumbing to a two-goal defeat at Stamford Bridge. During a rain-soaked 90 minutes in SW6, both sides created goalscoring opportunities across the 90 minutes. Cole Palmer forced Antonin Kinsky into a good first-half save, and Jordan Henderson, Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto were also denied by the Tottenham goalkeeper. Mike Penders made good stops of his own, first to deny Omar Marmoush and then Mathys Tel. However, with 13 minutes remaining, Tottenham forced a Penders own goal from a corner and, after Palmer was dismissed for two yellow cards, Tel struck late on to seal a rare Spurs' victory at Stamford Bridge. Alonso was honest in his post-match assessment, acknowledging the performance was not at the level the Blues had displayed in our back-to-back wins over Bournemouth and Everton. ‘We all take the blame for the result and for the performance,' he said. 'Today we were not at our best. I felt that in the second half, the game was even and could have gone either way. Once we conceded that first goal, and then with the red card, it was difficult.' The Blues manager continued: 'In the second half, it was tight, with some half-chances for them and half-chances for us. It was about taking a moment and once we conceded the first goal, it conceded everything. Then, when we wanted to have a reaction, we got the red card. Then it went the other way. 'We can do better. It's one to reflect after this big game that it was against a good opponent. And the performance, it's one to improve.' The Blues' preparation for the game was disrupted with Joao Pedro sustaining an injury in training on the eve of Tottenham's visit. And Alonso said the absence of the Brazilian forward did mean a late change to the game plan was needed. He said: 'We had to take many decisions in a short time. What we had been working on in the week, you need to be flexible and adapt. So it changed the idea we had a little bit, but this is football, and it can happen. 'It’s no secret that with Joao we are better, but it’s not about talking about the players missing. It’s about the players who were on the pitch. We can do better and we have to be critical of ourselves.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对对阵托特纳姆热刺队的表现和结果感到失望，并在斯坦福桥两球失利后承认他的切尔西队“可以做得更好”。在SW6的90分钟大雨中，双方都创造了进球机会。科尔·帕尔默迫使安东尼·金斯基上半场做出精彩扑救，乔丹·亨德森、摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托也被热刺门将挡出。迈克·彭德斯 (Mike Penders) 也做出了出色的防守，首先阻挡了奥马尔·马穆什 (Omar Marmoush)，然后阻挡了马蒂斯·特尔 (Mathys Tel)。然而，在比赛还剩13分钟时，托特纳姆热刺在角球中迫使彭德斯自摆乌龙，帕尔默因两张黄牌被罚下场后，特尔在最后时刻的进球帮助热刺在斯坦福桥取得了一场罕见的胜利。阿隆索在赛后评估中很诚实，他承认蓝军的表现没有达到我们在背靠背战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿时所表现出的水平。 “我们都为结果和表现承担责任，”他说。 “今天我们没有处于最佳状态。我觉得下半场比赛是势均力敌，双方都有可能获胜。一旦我们丢了第一个球，然后又吃到了红牌，那就很难了。”蓝军主教练继续说道：“下半场比赛很紧张，他们的机会各有一半，我们的机会也各有一半。这需要一点时间，一旦我们丢了第一个球，它就丢了一切。然后，当我们想要做出反应时，我们得到了红牌。然后事情又走向了另一条路。 '我们可以做得更好。在这场重要的比赛之后，我们要反思的是，这是对阵一个优秀的对手。性能也需要改进。”若昂·佩德罗在热刺造访前夕的训练中受伤，蓝军的比赛准备工作被打乱。阿隆索表示，巴西前锋的缺席确实意味着需要对比赛计划进行后期调整。他说：“我们必须在短时间内做出许多决定。我们这周一直在做的事情，你需要保持灵活性并适应。所以它稍微改变了我们的想法，但这就是足球，它是可能发生的。 “有了若奥，我们会变得更好，这已经不是什么秘密了，但这并不是在谈论球员的缺失。这是关于球场上的球员的。我们可以做得更好，但我们必须批评自己。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 0-2 Tottenham Hotspur
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 0-2 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: It proved a disappointing evening for the Blues at Stamford Bridge as we were beaten by Tottenham Hotspur. For much of the contest, little separated the two sides. In the opening period, Cole Palmer and Jordan Henderson forced Antonin Kinsky into good saves. Mike Penders, meanwhile, produced good stops to deny Omar Marmoush and Mathys Tel. The second period remained tight, but with 13 minutes to play, a Tottenham corner ended up in the Blues' goal via the hand of Penders, who was put under pressure by Jan Paul van Hecke. Palmer was then shown a red card after receiving two yellows inside ten minutes, and Tel netted late on for Tottenham to condemn the Blues to defeat. Xabi Alonso was forced to make two changes to his starting XI. Emi Martinez and Joao Pedro both missed out due to injuries –the latter sustaining an issue in training yesterday – and were replaced by Penders and Geovany Quenda. The opening 45 minutes were played in a downpour. It meant every touch had to be precise and every pass weighted perfectly. The Blues looked more threatening in the early stages and kept Tottenham at arm's length. Our first chance of note was fashioned as the game approached the quarter-hour mark. Pedro Neto started it as he won the ball near the corner flag and fed it to Morgan Rogers inside the box. The England international laid it first-time to Palmer, who whipped his shot to the far post from an acute angle. However, Antonin Kinsky saved well. As the half progressed, Spurs took a stranglehold of possession. Mohammed Kudus had the visitors' first shot of the evening – an attempt from inside the box that flew wide – before a good chance was created for Omar Marmoush from 10 yards. Penders reacted quickly to produce an excellent stop. The Belgian goalkeeper produced an even better save soon after, rushing out and diving at the feet of Mathys Tel to deny the forward's left-footed strike. Alonso's side responded to the Spurs' attempts. The first came following a mistake from Kinsky, which enabled Neto, Rogers and Palmer to exchange one-touch passes in the Tottenham penalty area and lay the ball to Henderson. The Blues midfielder attempted to guide his finish into the corner, but put it close enough to Kinsky to allow the goalkeeper to save. Rogers was next denied as he drove a left-footed strike at goal, but the offside flag was subsequently raised. Our final chance of the half fell to Neto, with a free-kick worked short to the Portuguese winger. He drove his shot to the near post, yet Kinsky got down to save and the game was goalless at the interval. The Blues have often made fast starts to second halves this season, but both sides nullified each other's threat in 15 minutes after the break. Much of the game was played in midfield, with attacks breaking down or being snuffed out. It wasn't until the hour mark that a shot was registered that threatened to break the deadlock. It came from Neto, who, after winning the ball and finding Palmer, reacted quickest to a rebound inside the area and drove a shot at Kinsky. The Tottenham stopper beat it behind for a corner. Our first change of the afternoon came soon after, with Marco Palestra coming on for Hato. The Italian dropped into a role on the left of our defence. Estevao's introduction followed; he replaced Quenda. Before the Brazilian's introduction came the game's biggest flashpoint. After Caicedo launched a counter-attack and was fouled in the process by van de Ven, a run from Palmer was halted by Mateus Fernandes falling and grabbing the ball. Several players came together, and three yellow cards followed, one of which went to Palmer. From the restart, we fashioned an opportunity as Palmer and Henderson combined to get Estevao in on goal from a tight angle. He fired at goal but into the side netting. With 13 minutes to play, and somewhat against the run of play, Tottenham went ahead. A corner was delivered into the Chelsea penalty area and van Hecke put Penders under pressure. The ball struck the hand of the Blues goalkeeper and deflected into our net despite Maxence Lacroix's efforts. Our task got harder as, three minutes later, Palmer caught Conor Gallagher in midfield and referee Chris Kavanagh deemed it worthy of a second yellow card, and a red followed. The game was effectively killed late on as a run and finish from Tel gave Tottenham a two-goal advantage in the closing stages, which they were able to see out to claim victory. The Blues are back in action on Wednesday evening as we take on Liverpool in the fourth round of the Carabao Cup. news.body_zh: 事实证明，蓝军在斯坦福桥度过了一个令人失望的夜晚，我们被托特纳姆热刺队击败。在比赛的大部分时间里，双方几乎没有分出胜负。开局阶段，科尔·帕尔默和乔丹·亨德森迫使安东尼·金斯基进行了精彩扑救。与此同时，迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders）做出了精彩的拦网，挡住了奥马尔·马穆什（Omar Marmoush）和马蒂斯·特尔（Mathys Tel）的进攻。第二节比赛形势依然胶着，但在比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队的角球最终通过潘德斯的手射入蓝军球门，潘德斯受到扬·保罗·范赫克的压力。帕尔默在十分钟内吃到两张黄牌后被出示红牌，而特尔在最后时刻为热刺攻入一球，宣告蓝军惨败。哈维·阿隆索被迫对首发阵容做出两次调整。埃米·马丁内斯和若昂·佩德罗均因伤缺席——后者在昨天的训练中出现问题——并被彭德斯和乔瓦尼·昆达顶替。开场45分钟是在倾盆大雨中进行的。这意味着每次触球都必须精确，每次传球都必须完美。蓝军在比赛初期看起来更具威胁性，并与托特纳姆热刺保持一定的距离。当比赛临近一刻钟时，我们第一次获得关注的机会出现了。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）在角旗附近赢得球并将球传给禁区内的摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）。这位英格兰国脚将球传给了帕尔默，帕尔默以锐角将球射向远门柱。然而，安东尼·金斯基保存得很好。随着上半场的进行，热刺牢牢掌握了控球权。穆罕默德·库杜斯 (Mohammed Kudus) 为客队打出了当晚的第一脚射门——一次从禁区内射门，但飞出了底线——随后奥马尔·马尔穆什 (Omar Marmoush) 在 10 码外创造了一个好机会。彭德斯反应迅速，完成了出色的停球。比利时门将很快做出了更好的扑救，冲出并扑到马蒂斯·特尔脚下，挡出了前锋的左脚射门。阿隆索的球队回应了马刺队的尝试。第一个进球发生在金斯基的失误之后，内托、罗杰斯和帕尔默在托特纳姆禁区内交换一脚传球，并将球传给了亨德森。蓝军中场试图将射门射入角球，但球距离金斯基足够近，让门将扑救。罗杰斯随后左脚射门被挡出，但越位旗随后被举起。我们上半场的最后一次机会落在了内托身上，葡萄牙边锋的任意球没能成功。他射门近门柱，但金斯基倒地扑救，中场休息时比赛没有进球。本赛季蓝军经常在下半场快速开局，但双方在中场休息后15分钟内就化解了对方的威胁。比赛的大部分时间都是在中场进行，进攻被破坏或被压制。直到一小时后，才有可能打破僵局的一枪。球来自内托，他在赢得球并找到帕尔默后，对禁区内的篮板反应最快，并向金斯基射门。托特纳姆热刺队的门将在后面抢到了角球。下午的第一次换人很快就到来了，马科·帕莱斯特拉换下了哈托。意大利人在我们后防线的左边发挥了作用。接下来是埃斯特沃的介绍；他取代了昆达。在巴西人上场之前，比赛最大的亮点出现了。在凯塞多发起反击并被范德文犯规后，帕尔默的跑动被马特乌斯·费尔南德斯摔倒并抢断。几名球员凑在一起，三张黄牌随之而来，其中一张是帕尔默的。从比赛重新开始，我们创造了一次机会，帕尔默和亨德森联手从小角度帮助埃斯特沃射门。他向球门射门，但射入了边网。比赛还剩 13 分钟时，托特纳姆热刺队取得了领先，这在一定程度上违背了比赛的节奏。切尔西禁区开出角球，范赫克给彭德斯施压。尽管马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 奋力拼搏，但球还是击中了蓝军门将的手并偏入了我们的球网。我们的任务变得更加艰巨，三分钟后，帕尔默在中场抓住了康纳·加拉格尔，裁判克里斯·卡瓦纳认为值得第二张黄牌，随后出示了一张红牌。比赛在最后阶段被终结，特尔的跑动和射门让托特纳姆热刺队在最后阶段取得了两球的优势，最终他们赢得了胜利。 周三晚上，蓝军将重返赛场，我们将在卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛中迎战利物浦。切尔西：彭德斯； Acheampong、Lacroix、Colwill、Hato（Palestra 65）；凯塞多 (c)、亨德森；内托 (维尔贝克 88)、帕尔默、昆达 (埃斯特瓦 72)；罗杰斯 切尔西替补：沙曼-洛、古斯托、福法纳、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利、拉维亚黄牌：帕尔默 71、内托 79、罗杰斯 90+1 被罚下：帕尔默 80 托特纳姆热刺：金斯基；格雷、范赫克、范德文、罗伯逊（佩德罗波罗 65）；马特乌斯·费尔南德斯、托纳利； Kudus (Kulusevski 89)、Maddison (Gallagher 51)、Tel (Davies 89)；马穆什（索兰克 65）托特纳姆热刺替补：杜布拉夫卡、塞内西、奥卢塞西、威廉姆斯-巴内特进球者：彭德斯 77、电话 87 黄牌：加拉格尔 67、范德文 71、马特乌斯·费尔南德斯 72

news.title_zh: 塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔加入切尔西传奇队迎战托特纳姆热刺

news.title: Alonso explains Joao Pedro absence against Tottenham
news.title_zh: 阿隆索解释若昂·佩德罗缺席对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Joao Pedro is not in the Chelsea squad for this afternoon’s game against Tottenham Hotspur – and emphasised the qualities Mike Penders and Geovany Quenda will bring on their full Premier League debuts. We are back at Stamford Bridge this afternoon for what the Blues manager expects to be an ‘intense game’ against our London rivals, whom we are aiming to defeat for an unprecedented seventh success in the Premier League. Alonso has made two changes to the team that started our win at Everton last weekend. One was expected as Penders replaces the injured Emi Martinez, who underwent jaw surgery after a nasty collision with Jarrad Branthwaite at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. The other is the absence of Joao Pedro, with Alonso explaining the Brazilian was ruled out of the contest yesterday. ‘He felt something yesterday in training,’ Alonso said. ‘At the moment, he has some fluid [around the injury], so we have to do some tests to see how big is the injury is. For sure, it’s a disappointment, but we need to carry on.’ Quenda is the man Alonso has opted to replace Joao Pedro with in the starting XI. It is the Portuguese winger’s first top-flight start in English football after his arrival in the summer. He has many qualities,’ Alonso said when asked about Quenda’s selection.’ He attacks the space well, is good with the ball, and is a threat. He’s been training well, and all the players will have their opportunities. Sometimes, they have to be more patient. Geo has been patient, and today it’s a big game to make his debut as a starter. 'We want to have mobility and to be fluid, so that we are not static and for sure with Geo we have those qualities.' Penders, meanwhile, starts in the Premier League for the first time, having made his debut off the bench against Everton last weekend. ‘I believe in every player we have and today it’s the first start in the PL for Mike,’ explained Alonso. ‘He showed last weekend against Everton that the can have a good impact. We need to deal with injuries and now he has a good chance, and we are fully confident.’ A big-game atmosphere is building at Stamford Bridge ahead of kick-off, and Alonso has highlighted the important role the Blues supporters play across the 90 minutes. 'It will be an intense game at a high tempo and high intensity on the pitch and in the stands. A proper derby. We expect an intense game with different moments for everything, with our qualities and the qualities of Tottenham. So it’s going to be very interesting.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么若昂·佩德罗没有出现在今天下午对阵托特纳姆热刺的切尔西大名单中，并强调了迈克·彭德斯和乔瓦尼·昆达将在他们的英超首秀中展现出的品质。今天下午我们回到斯坦福桥，蓝军主帅预计这将是一场对阵伦敦对手的“激烈比赛”，我们的目标是击败他们，在英超联赛中取得前所未有的第七次胜利。阿隆索对上周末我们在埃弗顿获胜的球队做出了两项调整。彭德斯接替受伤的埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez），后者在希尔·迪金森体育场与贾拉德·布兰斯韦特（Jarrad Branthwaite）发生严重碰撞后接受了下颌手术，这在预料之中。另一个是若昂·佩德罗的缺席，阿隆索解释说巴西人昨天被排除在比赛之外。 “他昨天在训练中感受到了一些东西，”阿隆索说。 “目前，他（伤处）有一些液体，所以我们必须做一些测试，看看伤势有多大。”当然，这令人失望，但我们需要继续前进。”昆达是阿隆索选择取代若昂·佩德罗进入首发阵容的人。这是这位葡萄牙边锋自夏天抵达英格兰足球以来首次在顶级联赛首发。当被问及昆达的选择时，阿隆索说道：“他有很多品质。”他的进攻空间很好，控球能力很好，并且是一个威胁。他训练得很好，所有球员都会有机会。有时，他们必须更有耐心。吉奥一直很有耐心，今天这是一场重要的比赛，他将作为首发登场。 “我们希望具有流动性和流动性，这样我们就不会一成不变，而且可以肯定的是，Geo 具备这些品质。”与此同时，彭德斯在上周末对阵埃弗顿的比赛中替补登场，首次在英超联赛中首发。 “我相信我们拥有的每一位球员，今天这是迈克在英超联赛中的第一次首发，”阿隆索解释道。 “他在上周末对阵埃弗顿的比赛中证明了他可以产生良好的影响。我们需要处理伤病问题，现在他有一个很好的机会，我们充满信心。”开球前，斯坦福桥正在营造一种重要的比赛氛围，阿隆索强调了蓝军球迷在整个 90 分钟中所发挥的重要作用。 “这将是一场在球场上和看台上高节奏、高强度的激烈比赛。一场真正的德比。我们期待一场激烈的比赛，每一件事都有不同的时刻，我们的实力和托特纳姆热刺的实力。所以这将会非常有趣。
