news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Tottenham

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made two changes to his Chelsea side for this evening's Premier League meeting with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. After defeating Bournemouth and then Everton, the Blues are targeting a third consecutive top-flight win – and an unprecedented seventh in the Premier League over Spurs. One change to the Chelsea starting XI was always going to be required, with Emi Martinez sidelined after undergoing jaw surgery following our win at Everton. Mike Penders comes into the side for his first Premier League start, and Alonso has also made one further alteration. Josh Acheampong, Maxence Lacroix, Levi Colwill and Jorrel Hato all continue in what is expected to be a back four, while Moises Caicedo captains the side and partners Jordan Henderson in midfield. Pedro Neto, who netted twice last time out, starts once more in an attack that also includes Cole Palmer, Geovany Quenda and Morgan Rogers. Joao Pedro is not in the match-day squad. news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: Chelsea 4-1 Ipswich Town

news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s came from behind to secure an impressive 4-1 victory over Ipswich Town at Cobham in the Under-18 Premier League, with Jacob Dako scoring a brace and Jacob Hall and Heze Grimwade always in target. After dominating the opening exchanges, the Blues fell behind in the 17th minute as Joel Ladegbaye swept home following an Ipswich counter-attack. We reacted positively, pushing for the leveller and probing the Ipswich back line on various occasions. Unfortunately, we couldn't apply a finishing touch before the break and went into the half-time interval a goal behind. The Blues continued to push in the second period, and our efforts paid off in the 66th minute as Dako found the net. That broke Ipswich's resistance and Hall netted soon after to put us ahead. We held that advantage until the closing stages – and then extended it as Ipswich attempted to salvage a point. Dako completed his double before Grimwade netted an excellent free-kick in stoppage time to seal a 4-1 victory. The Blues controlled the opening 15 minutes, although we were unable to consistently threaten the visitors' goal. Jashayde Greenwood did force a save from Ipswich goalkeeper Edward Twyman and Dako fired over the crossbar. After 17 minutes, we were punished on the counter, with Callum Stewart playing the final pass across the face of goal to enable Ladegbaye to sweep home and make it 1-0. We had a chance to level almost immediately, as Twyman raced out to clear his lines and missed the ball. Grimwade chased and lunged towards the ball, aiming to poke it into an empty net, but Pedro Felicio was there first to spare the goalkeeper’s blushes. We continued to search for an equaliser throughout the rest of the half. Ibrahim Rabbaj came close as he drifted inside and received the ball, but his left-footed attempt went just wide of the far post. We remained a persistent threat down the right, and Isaac McGillvary played a give-and-go with Rabbaj before cutting a pass to Greenwood. The Blues striker’s first-time shot was just off target. Towards the end of the half, Isaac Badu fashioned a great opportunity to level. The Portuguese youth international wriggled through midfield and played the ball to Greenwood, who lined up the shot before opting to tee up Rabbaj instead. But his shot was blocked and remained a goal down at the break. After the interval, it was more of the same, with the Blues holding onto the ball for long spells. Dako had two good chances in quick succession but was unable to convert either. Substitute Gabriel Sambou created the first, as he crossed into the penalty area for Dako, but he didn’t get enough on his header to steer it goalwards. Moments later, Greenwood drove towards goal and shimmied inside before laying the ball off to the midfielder, whose shot was dragged just wide. He was eventually rewarded with a goal, though. Captain Dante Waite played the ball behind the Tractor Boys’ defence, and Dako was able to tuck his finish into the net for his fifth league goal of the campaign. The Blues were a lot more like ourselves after Dako’s goal and, after Sambou had came agonisingly with a shot cleared off the line by Felicio. we scored our second just four minutes later. Hall gave us the advantage as he quickest when Twyman spilled a Dako free kick to place the ball into the corner. Having taken the lead, the Blues were oozing with confidence in the latter stages, and we began getting far more shots on target. Ipswich showed more attacking intent once they had fallen behind, but our defence handled the onslaught superbly. Dako then completed his brace to make it 3-1 with a neat finish into the bottom corner. The visitors' best chance fell to Kyle Messenger, who seemed set to halve the deficit. Toby Bell’s initial save was very impressive but the ball fell into Messenger’s path; fortunately, Hall made a fantastic recovery run and block. Grimwade got in on the action with the final kick of the game, scoring from a set piece once again. The 16-year-old wrapped the free-kick into the top left corner to end the game in style. This victory means we remain top of the table on 21 points, having won seven matches and scoring 37 goals. The Blues also extended our perfect run to five games. Chelsea Under-18s are back on the road next week when we face West Ham United on Saturday 31 October. The game gets underway at 11am BST and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 在 18 岁以下英超联赛中，切尔西 18 岁以下队后来居上，在科巴姆以 4-1 击败伊普斯维奇镇，雅各布·达科梅开二度，雅各布·霍尔和赫泽·格里姆韦德始终进球。在控制了开场比赛后，蓝军在第 17 分钟就落后了，乔尔·拉德格巴耶 (Joel Ladegbaye) 在伊普斯维奇 (Ipswich) 反击中破门得分。我们做出了积极的反应，在不同的场合推动扳平比分并探查伊普斯维奇的后防线。不幸的是，我们没能在中场休息前完成最后一击，以一球落后的方式进入中场休息。蓝军在第二节继续推进，我们的努力在第 66 分钟得到了回报，达科破门得分。这打破了伊普斯维奇的抵抗，霍尔很快就进球帮助我们取得领先。我们一直保持着这一优势，直到最后阶段，然后随着伊普斯维奇试图挽回一分，我们扩大了优势。达科完成梅开二度，格里姆韦德在补时阶段打进一脚精彩的任意球，帮助球队4-1获胜。蓝军控制了开场 15 分钟，尽管我们无法持续威胁客队的球门。贾沙德·格林伍德迫使伊普斯维奇门将爱德华·特威曼做出扑救，达科的射门高出横梁。第 17 分钟，我们在反击中受到惩罚，卡勒姆·斯图尔特 (Callum Stewart) 的最后一脚传球穿过球门，拉德巴耶 (Ladegbaye) 破门得分，1-0。我们几乎有机会立即扳平比分，但特威曼冲出去清理他的防线，却错过了球。格里姆韦德追赶皮球，打算将球射入空门，但佩德罗·费利西奥率先赶到，避免了守门员的脸红。在下半场剩下的时间里，我们继续寻找扳平比分的机会。易卜拉欣·拉巴伊 (Ibrahim Rabbaj) 内线接球时差点就到了，但他的左脚射门稍稍偏出远门柱。我们在右路仍然是一个持续的威胁，艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（Isaac McGillvary）与拉巴杰（Rabbaj）进行了一次传球，然后将球传给了格林伍德（Greenwood）。蓝军前锋的第一次射门刚刚偏离目标。半场结束时，艾萨克·巴杜创造了一次扳平比分的绝佳机会。这位葡萄牙青年国脚在中场蠕动，将球传给格林伍德，格林伍德将球对准，然后选择为拉巴伊发球。但他的射门被封堵，在中场休息时仍落后一球。中场休息后，情况基本相同，蓝军长时间控球。达科连续两次获得好机会，但都未能转化。替补球员加布里埃尔·桑布 (Gabriel Sambou) 创造了第一个进球，他传中达科的禁区，但他的头球攻门不够，未能将球射向球门。过了一会儿，格林伍德冲向球门，在内线晃动，然后将球传给中场球员，后者的射门稍稍偏出。不过，他最终还是收获了进球。队长丹特·韦特（Dante Waite）在拖拉机男孩队的防守后面打球，达科（Dako）将球射入球网，这是他本赛季的第五个联赛进球。在达科进球之后，在桑布痛苦地射门被费利西奥挡出底线之后，蓝军更像我们自己了。仅仅四分钟后我们就取得了第二个进球。当特威曼传出达科任意球将球送入角球时，霍尔为我们带来了优势，因为他速度最快。取得领先后，蓝军在后期充满了信心，我们开始获得更多的射正机会。伊普斯维奇在落后时表现出了更多的进攻意图，但我们的防守很好地应对了进攻。达科随后完成梅开二度，将比分改写为3-1，并漂亮地射入底角。客队最好的机会落到了凯尔·梅辛杰身上，他似乎将把比分差距缩小一半。托比·贝尔（Toby Bell）最初的扑救令人印象深刻，但皮球落入了梅塞辛斯（Messenger）的路径中；幸运的是，霍尔做出了出色的恢复跑动和拦网。格里姆韦德在比赛最后一脚发挥出色，再次定位球得分。这位16岁的球员将任意球打入左上角，以优雅的方式结束了比赛。这场胜利意味着我们以 21 分继续排名榜首，赢得了 7 场比赛并攻入 37 个进球。蓝军还将我们的完美连胜延续到了五场比赛。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于下周重返客场，届时我们将在 10 月 31 日星期六对阵西汉姆联队。比赛于英国夏令时上午 11 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。 切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔； Dante Waite (中)、Jacob Hall、Calvin Diakite、Yisa Alao (Gabriel Sambou
